summary_en: It is used for educational purposes. It has been adopted in university-level introductory CS courses, including UC Berkeley's "Beauty and Joy of Computing," and is valued as teaching material that conveys substantial computational theory despite being a block-based language.

name: Greenfoot
problem: オブジェクト指向プログラミングの概念(クラス、オブジェクト、継承など)を初学者に視覚的かつ対話的に教えたかった。Java言語をベースにしながら、2Dのシミュレーションやゲームをその場で動かして確認できる教育環境を提供したかった。
summary: Javaベースでオブジェクト指向を視覚的に学べる教育用プログラミング環境。
problem_en: Classes, objects, inheritance, and polymorphism, the core concepts of object-oriented programming, are difficult for beginners to grasp by just looking at code. Greenfoot tackled this problem by letting learners experience these concepts, based on the practical language Java, in the visible form of 2D simulations and games. Because the code you write can be seen immediately as a character's movement on screen, it aimed to be an educational environment where the correspondence between class definitions and object behavior could be learned intuitively.
summary_en: Greenfoot is used for educational purposes. It continues to be adopted today as teaching material for practically learning object orientation, in introductory Java courses ranging from secondary education to university general education.

name: Karel
problem: プログラミング初学者に、複雑な構文の詳細に煩わされることなく、手続き的思考(命令の順序、繰り返し、条件分岐)を学ばせたかった。ロボットを架空の世界の中で動かすという直感的なメタファーを使い、抽象的なプログラミング概念を具体的なタスクとして体験させたかった。
summary: ロボットを動かして手続き型プログラミングの基礎を学ぶ教育用言語。
problem_en: For people learning to program for the first time, the syntactic details of a language tend to get in the way of essential thinking. Karel was created to teach the fundamentals of procedural programming — instruction sequencing, iteration, and conditional branching — separated from syntactic complexity. It adopted the intuitive metaphor of moving a robot named Karel around an imaginary grid world, letting learners experience abstract control-structure concepts as concrete tasks like "cross a wall" or "pick up a beeper," softening the learning curve for beginners.
summary_en: Karel is used for educational purposes. It has been a staple teaching tool in introductory computer science education since the 1980s, and it continues to be used today in introductory university courses as a first step into procedural programming.

name: GDScript
problem: ゲームエンジンGodotのシーンツリーやノードベースのアーキテクチャに最適化された、軽量で書きやすいスクリプト言語が欲しかった。Pythonライクな読みやすい構文を持ちながら、汎用のPythonをそのまま組み込むよりも高速に動作する専用言語を独自に用意したかった。
summary: Godotエンジン専用に設計された、Python風の軽量ゲームスクリプト言語。
problem_en: The Godot game engine adopted a unique architecture based on a scene tree and nodes, and simply embedding a general-purpose scripting language as-is would not provide the writability or execution efficiency optimized for that architecture. GDScript was designed as a dedicated language that has readable, simple syntax similar to Python while natively supporting concepts such as Godot's nodes, signals (event notifications), and scenes. Another aim was to make it run more lightly and quickly than embedding a general-purpose Python implementation as-is.
summary_en: It is currently in wide use. As the standard scripting language of the open-source Godot game engine, its adoption is expanding, particularly among indie game developers.

name: UnrealScript
problem: Unreal Engine上でゲームロジックやAI、UIなどを、C++でエンジン本体を再ビルドすることなく高水準かつ迅速に記述したかった。オブジェクト指向、ガベージコレクション、状態機械、遅延実行などゲーム開発に便利な機能を言語レベルで提供したかった。
summary: Unreal Engineのゲームロジック記述用に開発された独自オブジェクト指向スクリプト言語。
problem_en: There was a demand to be able to develop and iterate quickly on the parts of the Unreal Engine that changed frequently — game logic, AI, and UI — without having to rebuild the engine itself in C++. UnrealScript aimed to allow game code to be written at a higher level and more quickly than in C++, by providing game-development-specific features at the language level, such as object orientation, garbage collection, state machines, and latent functions. The architectural decision to separate the engine from game logic also lay behind the origin of this language.
summary_en: UnrealScript is treated as legacy. From Unreal Engine 4 onward it was replaced by C++ and the visual scripting system Blueprint, and UnrealScript itself has already been discontinued, though it remains as a legacy asset in games and mods from the Unreal Engine 3 generation.

name: Papyrus
problem: 『The Elder Scrolls』シリーズなどのMOD開発者に対し、従来のBethesda独自スクリプト言語よりも構造化された、オブジェクト指向かつイベント駆動のスクリプト記述手段を提供したかった。クエストやNPCの振る舞いなど複雑化するゲームロジックを、保守しやすい形で書けるようにしたかった。
summary: Skyrim以降のBethesdaゲームでMOD開発に使われるオブジェクト指向スクリプト言語。
problem_en: Bethesda games such as the *The Elder Scrolls* series had for many years used a proprietary, unstructured scripting language to write mods and quest logic, but there were limits to how well this could maintain increasingly complex game logic. Papyrus was introduced starting with Skyrim as a scripting language that adopted modern design based on object orientation and event-driven programming, allowing complex elements such as quests and NPC behavior to be described in a more structured form. The aim was to give the mod-developer community a scripting tool with high maintainability and extensibility.
summary_en: It is a niche language used in a specific field. Specialized to the limited domain of mod development for Bethesda games, it continues to be used within that domain as an active language with a currently thriving community.

name: AutoIt
problem: Windows上のGUIアプリケーション操作やシステム管理作業を手軽に自動化したかった。プログラミング初心者でも扱えるようBASICに似た平易な構文を採用し、ウィンドウやコントロールを直接操作できる自動化スクリプトを誰でも書けるようにしたかった。
summary: Windowsアプリの操作自動化に特化した、BASIC風の軽量スクリプト言語。
problem_en: There was demand to automate GUI application operations and system administration tasks on Windows without requiring specialized programming skills. AutoIt was designed as a scripting language that adopted a plain, BASIC-like syntax to make it accessible even to programming beginners, while also providing a mechanism to directly specify and operate on window titles and controls — allowing anyone to easily automate repetitive tasks and software testing.
summary_en: It is widely used and active today. There is persistent demand for it as a tool that even staff without specialized knowledge can use, in the fields of Windows business automation and software testing.

name: AutoHotkey
problem: Windows上でのキーボードショートカット割り当てやマクロ作成、GUI操作の自動化を、専門的なプログラミング知識がないユーザーでも手軽に行えるようにしたかった。AutoItの構文を土台にホットキー機能を組み込むことで、反復作業の自動化を誰もが扱えるツールにすることを目指した。
summary: Windowsの操作自動化とホットキー割り当てに特化したスクリプト言語。
problem_en: For ordinary users on Windows who wanted to assign keyboard shortcuts, create macros, and automate GUI operations, most existing tools were either limited in functionality or difficult to use. Building on the syntax of its predecessor AutoIt while incorporating hotkey functionality at the core of the language, AutoHotkey aimed to make automating repetitive tasks and creating custom key bindings something anyone could do, without needing specialized programming knowledge.
summary_en: AutoHotkey is in active, widespread use. It has maintained high popularity for many years in the field of keyboard customization and business-process automation scripts among Windows users.

name: Rexx
problem: IBMメインフレーム(CMS)で使われていたEXEC/EXEC 2スクリプト言語を置き換え、PL/Iのような表現力を持ちながらも初心者にも学びやすい汎用マクロ言語を作りたかった。あらゆるアプリケーションに組み込める「グルー言語」として設計された。
summary: IBMメインフレーム発の、平易な構文を持つ汎用スクリプト/マクロ言語。
problem_en: On IBM mainframes (CMS), EXEC and EXEC 2 were used as scripting languages, but they had limited functionality and insufficient expressiveness for writing more complex processing. Rexx was designed as a general-purpose macro language that had the expressiveness of a full-fledged programming language like PL/I, while also having a syntax simple enough for beginners to learn. A major characteristic is that it was designed as a "glue language" that was not tied to any particular application and could be embedded into any program.
summary_en: Rexx is a niche language used in specific fields. It continues to be used today in the maintenance and operation of IBM mainframe and OS/2 environments, but its adoption in new development has become limited.

name: Vyper
problem: 先行するSolidityは表現力が高い反面、継承やオーバーロード等の機能が悪用されバグや脆弱性の温床になりやすいという課題があった。そこでPythonライクな読みやすい構文を採用しつつ、意図的に機能を削ぎ落とし、監査しやすく安全なスマートコントラクトを書けるようにしたかった。
summary: 監査のしやすさと安全性を重視した、Python風構文のイーサリアム向けスマートコントラクト言語。
problem_en: The earlier smart contract language Solidity was highly expressive, but features such as inheritance, function overloading, and complex modifiers could be abused or become a breeding ground for unintended behavior, causing many vulnerabilities. Vyper aimed to adopt readable, Python-like syntax while deliberately stripping away language features, so that auditors could reliably grasp a contract's behavior and write secure smart contracts that were harder to exploit.
summary_en: It is actively used and in wide use today. It has not reached Solidity's level of adoption, but it continues to be used by projects that prioritize safety and by some DeFi-related contracts.

name: Move
problem: Facebook(Libra/Diem)のブロックチェーン上で、デジタル資産を「リソース」として型システムレベルで安全に扱い、複製や誤った消失を防ぎたかった。Solidityのようなスマートコントラクト言語で頻発する資産の二重利用や消失といったバグを、言語仕様そのもので防止することを目指した。
summary: 資産をリソース型として安全に扱う、ブロックチェーン向けスマートコントラクト言語。
problem_en: In the Libra/Diem blockchain project led by Facebook (as it was then known), bugs such as the double-spending or accidental loss of digital assets kept recurring in smart contracts that handled those assets. Move aimed to prevent such bugs at the level of the language specification itself by treating digital assets as a special type called a "resource," and enforcing through the type system the constraint that such values can be neither duplicated nor implicitly discarded. It was designed as a fundamental response to the asset-management vulnerabilities that had occurred in existing smart-contract languages such as Solidity.
summary_en: Actively and widely used. The Libra/Diem project itself has ended, but the Move language has been adopted by newer blockchain platforms such as Aptos and Sui, and development continues.

name: SAS
problem: ノースカロライナ州立大学で農業データの統計解析を行うためのソフトウェアが必要とされ、複数の大学が共同でデータ管理と統計解析を一体的に扱えるシステムを作りたかった。後に企業として独立し、ビジネスインテリジェンス全般に対応できるよう発展した。
summary: 統計解析とビジネスインテリジェンスに広く使われる商用データ解析システム。
problem_en: In the late 1960s, North Carolina State University needed software for statistical analysis of agricultural data, but the tools of the time kept data management and statistical analysis separate, making them cumbersome to use. SAS began as a project jointly developed by several universities, aiming to build a system that could handle data reading, transformation, aggregation, and statistical analysis consistently within a single framework. It later became an independent company, SAS Institute, and grew into a platform covering not just statistical analysis but business intelligence in general.
summary_en: SAS remains in wide, active use. It continues to be used as a standard tool in fields requiring regulatory compliance, such as clinical trial data analysis in the pharmaceutical industry and risk analysis at financial institutions.

name: Stata
problem: 1980年代半ば、パーソナルコンピュータ上で手頃に使える統計解析ソフトウェアが限られていたため、研究者が自分でプログラムを拡張しながらデータ管理・統計解析・可視化を一貫して行える環境を提供したかった。
summary: 経済学・疫学・社会科学分野で広く使われる統計解析用ソフトウェア。
problem_en: In the mid-1980s, personal computer performance was improving, but statistical analysis software that could be used affordably on such machines was still limited. Stata was developed with the aim of allowing researchers to carry out data management, statistical analysis, and visualization consistently within a single environment. It also aimed to provide a flexible system capable of keeping up with ever-evolving research needs by letting users themselves extend commands and incorporate their own statistical methods and analytical procedures.
summary_en: It is actively and widely used today. It continues to be widely used by researchers and analysts in economics, epidemiology, and the social sciences, and it retains its standing as a tool that supports the reproducibility of academic research.

name: OpenSCAD
problem: 3Dプリンタや工作機械向けの立体モデルを、マウス操作のインタラクティブCADではなくスクリプトで記述し、寸法変更やバージョン管理、再利用がしやすいパラメトリックな設計を可能にしたかった。
summary: 3Dモデルをコードで記述するプログラマー志向のパラメトリックCADスクリプト言語。
problem_en: When creating solid models for 3D printers or machine tools, interactive CAD tools operated by mouse made it difficult to rebuild a model from scratch or track a change history even for a slight change in dimensions. OpenSCAD aimed to make parameter changes, version control, and reuse easier by describing solid models as script code, allowing precise, reproducible 3D design in a programmer-like manner.
summary_en: OpenSCAD is a niche language used in a specific field. It enjoys persistent support as a parametric model-design tool, mainly within the 3D printing enthusiast and maker-movement communities.

name: Jsonnet
problem: Google社内で肥大化した大量のJSON/YAML設定ファイルの重複や保守性の低さを解消し、継承やミックスイン、関数によって設定を体系的に生成・再利用したかった。
summary: JSONを拡張し関数とオブジェクト指向でテンプレート化する設定生成言語。
problem_en: Within Google, the JSON/YAML files describing service configurations had grown bloated, producing large numbers of duplicated copies to express subtle differences between environments, which severely degraded maintainability. Jsonnet aimed to extend JSON with programming-language-like features such as variables, functions, inheritance, and mixins, so that configuration files could be generated and reused systematically. A defining characteristic is that it was designed not as a template engine, but as a pure functional language that itself outputs JSON.
summary_en: It is a niche language used in a specific field. It continues to be used as a tool for reusing and generating complex configuration in the field of cloud infrastructure configuration management, centered around Kubernetes.

name: HCL
problem: TerraformをはじめとするHashiCorp製ツール向けに、JSONより人間が読み書きしやすく、かつ汎用プログラミング言語ほど複雑にならない構造化設定フォーマットを作りたかった。
summary: HashiCorp製ツール群のための人間可読な構造化設定記述言語。
problem_en: HCL (HashiCorp Configuration Language) is a configuration language created for HashiCorp's tools, including Terraform. At the time, JSON was commonly used as a configuration format for managing infrastructure as code, but JSON does not allow comments, is strict about trailing commas, and was hard for humans to read and write by hand. On the other hand, using a general-purpose programming language directly for configuration description would raise the learning cost too much and make the syntax overly complex. HashiCorp wanted something in between: a structured format that was easy for humans to read and write, yet also easy for machines to handle. It was also a design requirement that it be interconvertible with JSON, aiming for compatibility with existing JSON-based toolchains.
summary_en: It is actively and widely used today. In particular, in the practice of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, it has established itself as the de facto standard configuration language, and is used on a daily basis in the field of building and managing cloud infrastructure.

name: Nix
problem: ソフトウェアのビルドとデプロイにつきまとう「依存関係地獄」を解消し、副作用のない純粋関数型の記述によって再現性と信頼性の高いパッケージ管理を実現したかった。
summary: 再現可能なビルドのための純粋関数型・遅延評価パッケージ記述言語。
problem_en: Nix is a purely functional package description language designed to resolve the "dependency hell" that plagues software building and deployment. In conventional package management systems, updating one package would frequently break another, or build results would vary depending on the environment. As doctoral research, Eelco Dolstra conceived of treating a package build as a pure function without side effects, deriving a unique path in a store from the hash value of its inputs (source code and dependent packages). This was meant to simultaneously achieve reproducibility, where the same inputs always yield the same result, and reliability, where different versions of packages can coexist without conflict.
summary_en: Nix is actively and widely used today. As the core language of the NixOS distribution and the Nix package manager, it retains strong support in communities that prioritize reproducible builds and development environments.

name: Dhall
problem: YAMLやJSONの設定ファイルにありがちな重複やテンプレートエンジンの濫用を避けつつ、チューリング完全性をあえて排除して評価が必ず停止する安全な「プログラム可能な設定言語」を作りたかった。
summary: 関数と型を持ちながら停止性が保証された全域関数型設定言語。
problem_en: Dhall was designed to avoid both the content duplication that tends to occur when writing configuration files in YAML or JSON, and the complexity and opacity that results from bringing in template engines or scripts to solve that duplication. There are many situations where one wants "a little function" or "a variable" in a configuration file, but bringing a general-purpose programming language into that context creates the risk of infinite loops and unexpected side effects. Gabriel Gonzalez set out to achieve safe "programmable configuration" by creating a configuration language that has functions and a type system, while deliberately excluding Turing completeness, guaranteeing that every expression is "total" — that it always finishes evaluating in finite time.
summary_en: Dhall is positioned as a niche language used in specific fields. There are cases of adoption in safety-focused configuration management and in writing large-scale configuration files with complex dependencies, but it is hard to say that it has achieved broad, general popularity.

name: Starlark
problem: BazelのBUILDファイル記述のために、決定的かつ再現可能にビルドを解析・並列実行できる、Pythonに似た読みやすい組み込みスクリプト言語を作りたかった。
summary: ビルドツール向けに設計された決定的で並列評価に安全なPythonライクな組み込み言語。
problem_en: Starlark is a language designed for writing BUILD files in Google's build tool, Bazel. Build configurations often become complex, and a simple declarative format alone lacks sufficient expressive power; yet allowing arbitrary shell scripts or general-purpose languages makes build analysis, parallel execution, and cache-validity determination extremely difficult. Starlark adopted a familiar, Python-like syntax while deliberately restricting the language's features, aiming to guarantee that evaluation of build files would be deterministic and could be safely analyzed and executed in parallel.
summary_en: It is currently in wide use. It has established itself as the standard language for describing build configurations in large-scale software projects that adopt Bazel.

name: ClojureScript
problem: Clojureの持つ永続データ構造や関数型・並行処理の設計思想をそのままブラウザなどJavaScript実行環境でも使いたかった。サーバー側(JVM上のClojure)とクライアント側で同じ言語・同じコードベースを共有し、フロントエンドとバックエンドの実装の分断を解消したかった。
summary: ClojureをJavaScript環境向けにコンパイルするLisp方言。
problem_en: ClojureScript arose from the desire to apply the persistent data structures and functional, concurrency-oriented design philosophy of Clojure, which runs on the JVM, directly to environments where JavaScript runs, such as the browser. In frontend development at the time, developers were forced to use completely different languages and paradigms on the server side and the client side, making it difficult to share code and maintain consistent design thinking. Rich Hickey and David Nolen created a system that compiles Clojure code to JavaScript, aiming to eliminate the divide between frontend and backend implementations by using the same language and the same way of thinking on both the server and the client.
summary_en: ClojureScript is in active, widespread use. It has established itself as an option for frontend development within the Clojure community, and continues to be used for practical web application development together with frameworks such as reagent and re-frame.

name: Unison
problem: コードの内容そのものをハッシュで一意に識別することで、依存関係の衝突やビルドのやり直し、環境差異による問題を根本から解消したかった。また、分散システム上でコードや計算を場所を意識せずシームレスに移動・実行できるようにしたかった。
summary: コードをハッシュで一意に識別する分散指向の静的型付け関数型言語。
problem_en: Unison is a statically typed functional language that started from the idea of computing a hash value from the content of code itself and using that hash to uniquely identify the code. In conventional languages, the problem of "code that should work but doesn't" frequently arose from dependency conflicts, rebuilds, and subtle differences between development environments. Paul Chiusano and Rúnar Bjarnason reasoned that if functions and their definitions could be uniquely identified by a hash, then name collisions and version inconsistencies would become impossible in principle. There was also a further aim: using this content-addressed representation of code would make it possible to move and execute code, and computation itself, seamlessly across a distributed system without regard to location.
summary_en: It is positioned as a niche language used in a specific field. It is adopted in experimental projects, mainly among a developer community interested in the advanced ideas of content-addressed code and distributed computation.

name: Roc
problem: Elmが持つ親しみやすい構文や親切なコンパイラエラー、堅牢な型推論の良さを、ブラウザ用途に留まらない汎用プログラミングの領域に広げたかった。関数型言語でありながら高速なネイティブ/WebAssemblyコードにコンパイルできるようにしたかった。
summary: Elm譲りの親しみやすさと高速なコンパイル性能を両立させた汎用関数型言語。
problem_en: Roc (its name is derived from "Rock solid," though this is not a former name) was created to extend the good qualities of Elm — its approachable syntax, helpful compiler error messages, and robust type inference — into the domain of general-purpose programming, not limited to browser use. Elm was extremely practical, specialized for web front-end use, but there was no general-purpose language that carried forward its design philosophy. Richard Feldman aimed to create a fast language that preserved Elm-like readability and safety while being usable in a wide range of contexts, such as server-side programming, command-line tools, and scripting. Despite being a functional language, it also places emphasis on execution performance, compiling efficiently to native code and WebAssembly.
summary_en: It is positioned as a niche language used in a specific domain. It is still in development, at a pre-1.0 stage, but it is attracting attention from the functional-language community as an attempt to extend Elm's design philosophy into the general-purpose domain.

name: Lean
problem: 数学の定理を厳密に形式化し、機械によって正しさを検証できる証明支援系を作りたかった。同時に、その証明システムを実用的な依存型プログラミング言語としても使えるようにしたかった。
summary: 数学の定理を形式化・検証する依存型の証明支援系兼関数型言語。
problem_en: Lean was designed as a proof assistant for rigorously formalizing mathematical theorems and verifying their correctness by machine. Mathematical proofs were becoming complex enough that oversights could occur with human review alone, and formal verification by computer was in demand. Leonardo de Moura aimed to build a proof assistant based on dependent type theory, while also making the type system underlying it usable as a practical dependently typed programming language. The central idea of Lean is that the act of writing proofs and the act of writing programs can be handled in a unified way, on the same language and the same type system.
summary_en: Lean is in active, widespread use. It has been adopted as one of the leading systems in mathematical formalization projects and theorem-proving research, and continues to be actively used by both mathematicians and computer scientists.

name: Q#
designers: Microsoft Quantum Architectures and Computation (QuArC) team
problem: 量子ビットの重ね合わせやエンタングルメントといった量子力学特有の概念を、既存の汎用言語の枠組みを流用するのではなく専用の抽象化として表現できる言語が欲しかった。量子計算と古典的な制御コードを自然に統合したかった。
summary: Microsoftが開発した量子アルゴリズム記述専用のプログラミング言語。
problem_en: Q# is a language designed to naturally express, as a dedicated abstraction, concepts unique to quantum mechanics such as qubit superposition and entanglement, rather than forcibly repurposing the framework of existing classical programming languages. Attempts to write quantum computing algorithms as libraries in C++ or Python already existed, but it was difficult to handle quantum operations and classical control flow together within a single language in an integrated, type-safe way. Microsoft's team aimed to create a dedicated language that would let quantum-algorithm researchers describe the algorithm itself without being overly conscious of the details of actual hardware or simulators, while still integrating seamlessly with classical control code.
summary_en: It is in active, wide use. As the core language of Microsoft's Quantum Development Kit, it continues to be used in the research, education, and experimental development of quantum algorithms.

name: AssemblyScript
problem: WebAssemblyは高速な実行を可能にしたが、それを使うにはC++やRustのような新しい言語を学ぶ必要があった。TypeScriptに慣れたJavaScript開発者が、使い慣れた構文のまま厳格な型付けでWebAssemblyへ直接コンパイルできるようにしたかった。
summary: TypeScript風構文でWebAssemblyに直接コンパイルできる言語。
problem_en: AssemblyScript came about to let developers accustomed to JavaScript/TypeScript more easily take advantage of WebAssembly's fast execution performance. Compiling to WebAssembly previously required learning a new language from scratch, such as C++ or Rust, which posed a high barrier to entry for web developers. Daniel Wirtz and Max Graey aimed to create a language that existing JavaScript/TypeScript developers could compile directly to WebAssembly while sticking with syntax they were already used to, by adopting syntax nearly identical to TypeScript while making it compilable as a strictly statically typed subset.
summary_en: It is actively used and in wide use today. It continues to be used as an approachable option for TypeScript-experienced developers in the development of high-performance web applications and plugin systems using WebAssembly.

name: VBA
problem: WordBasicなどアプリケーションごとにバラバラで非互換だったマクロ言語を統一し、Office製品全体で共通に使える自動化言語を提供したかった。プロのプログラマーでなくても業務ユーザーが定型作業を自動化できるようにしたかった。
summary: Microsoft Office製品向けに統一されたマクロ自動化言語。
problem_en: VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) was created to unify the macro languages that had previously been scattered and incompatible across Microsoft Office products (such as Excel's own macros and WordBasic). Having to relearn a different macro language every time the application changed was inefficient for both developers and users. By embedding a common macro language based on Visual Basic across the entire Office product line, Microsoft made it so that once someone learned it, they could use the same language across multiple applications such as Excel, Word, Access, and PowerPoint. At the same time, importance was placed on being an automation language open to non-engineers as well, so that business users who were not professional programmers could automate routine tasks.
summary_en: Actively and widely used. It remains overwhelmingly popular today in business automation and macro writing centered on Office products such as Excel, and has spread widely even among non-engineer business users.

name: BLISS
problem: 1960年代末、DEC PDP-10などのミニコンピュータ向けにOSやコンパイラを開発する際、アセンブリ言語では生産性が低く、既存の高水準言語(ALGOLやPL/Iなど)は移植性や実行効率、ハードウェアへの直接アクセスの面で不十分だった。カーネギーメロン大学のWulfらは、構造化プログラミングの利点を保ちながら、レジスタ操作など機械語に近い制御も可能な、型を持たない式指向のシステム記述言語としてBLISSを設計した。これによりPDP-10向けOSやコンパイラの開発が高水準言語で行えるようになった。後にC言語の普及により主流の座を譲ったが、DEC/VSIはOpenVMS向けにBLISSコンパイラを現在も保守している。
summary: PDP-10などDEC機のOS・コンパイラ開発のために作られた、型を持たない式指向のシステムプログラミング言語。
problem_en: In the late 1960s, developing operating systems and compilers for DEC minicomputers such as the PDP-10 in assembly language was unproductive, while existing high-level languages (such as ALGOL and PL/I) fell short in portability, execution efficiency, and direct access to hardware. Wulf and his colleagues at Carnegie Mellon University designed BLISS as a typeless, expression-oriented systems language that retained the benefits of structured programming while still allowing machine-level control such as register manipulation. This made it possible to develop OSes and compilers for the PDP-10 in a high-level language. It later ceded its mainstream position to C, but DEC/VSI continues to maintain a BLISS compiler for OpenVMS to this day.
summary_en: BLISS is positioned as a niche language, and with the spread of C its role as a systems-implementation language for new development has essentially ended. However, DEC/VSI still maintains a BLISS compiler for certain OpenVMS components, and it continues to see limited use within legacy VMS environments.

name: POP-11
problem: 1970年代、人工知能研究や教育の現場では、Lispの括弧だらけの構文が初学者や手続き型言語(Pascalなど)に慣れたプログラマにとって障壁となっていた。エディンバラ大学のPopplestoneらは、前身のPOP-2を発展させ、記号処理・関数型・宣言型の機能を手続き型に近い構文で提供するPOP-11を設計した。スタックモデルなどForthに由来する設計も取り入れ、対話的な開発環境とインクリメンタルコンパイルを備えた。AI教育・研究用の統合環境Poplogの中核言語として長く利用された。
summary: AI研究・教育向けに手続き型的な構文で記号処理を可能にした、Poplog環境の中核となるマルチパラダイム言語。
problem_en: In the 1970s, in AI research and education, Lisp's heavily parenthesized syntax was a barrier for beginners and for programmers accustomed to procedural languages such as Pascal. Popplestone and colleagues at the University of Edinburgh built on their earlier language POP-2 to design POP-11, which offered symbolic-processing, functional, and declarative features through a syntax closer to procedural style. It also incorporated design elements derived from Forth, such as a stack-based model, and came with an interactive development environment and incremental compilation. It was used for a long time as the core language of Poplog, an integrated environment for AI education and research.
summary_en: POP-11 is positioned as a niche language and is rarely used in new software development today. However, it is still referenced within the historical lineage of AI research and education alongside the Poplog environment, and continues to be maintained and used by some educational institutions and researchers.

name: REFAL
problem: 1960年代のソ連では、文字列やリスト構造を扱う記号計算(自然言語処理や数式処理、プログラム変換など)を、数学的に単純明快でありながら大規模なプログラム作成にも実用的な言語で行いたいという要求があった。Valentin Turchinは、Lispのリスト指向とは異なる、パターンマッチと項書き換え(term rewriting)に基づく関数型言語Refalを設計し、木構造データの変換を自然に表現できるようにした。以降Refal-2、Refal-5などの実装が作られ、記号処理研究やプログラム変換理論の分野で使われ続けている。
summary: パターンマッチと項書き換えに基づく、記号計算向けのソ連生まれの関数型言語。
problem_en: In the Soviet Union of the 1960s, there was a demand for a language that could perform symbolic computation over strings and list structures (such as natural language processing, symbolic mathematics, and program transformation) in a way that was both mathematically simple and clear, yet practical for writing large-scale programs. Valentin Turchin designed Refal, a functional language based on pattern matching and term rewriting rather than Lisp's list orientation, making it possible to express transformations of tree-structured data naturally. Later implementations such as Refal-2 and Refal-5 were built, and the language has continued to be used in symbolic-processing research and the theory of program transformation.
summary_en: REFAL is positioned as a niche language with very limited practical use today. On the other hand, as the origin of the program-transformation theory of "supercompilation" proposed by Turchin, it continues to attract academic interest in the field of program optimization and transformation research.

name: SETL
problem: 1960年代末、NYUのJack Schwartzらは、集合論に基づく数学的記法をそのままプログラムとして実行できる超高水準言語を作れば、アルゴリズムの試作や仕様記述が容易になると考えた。SETLは集合・タプルとその演算(和集合、内包表記、べき集合など)を言語の第一級要素として提供し、実装の詳細を隠したまま高いレベルでアルゴリズムを記述できるようにした。信頼性の高いAdaコンパイラ(NYU Ada/ED)の実装などに使われたほか、Lambert MeertensがSETLの集合指向の考え方をABC(後のPythonに影響)に持ち込むなど、後続言語の設計にも影響を与えた。
summary: 集合論の概念を直接プログラムとして書ける、NYUで開発された超高水準プロトタイピング言語。
problem_en: In the late 1960s, Jack Schwartz and colleagues at NYU believed that creating a very high-level language in which set-theoretic mathematical notation could be executed directly as a program would make algorithm prototyping and specification writing much easier. SETL provided sets, tuples, and their operations (union, set-builder notation, power sets, and so on) as first-class elements of the language, allowing algorithms to be written at a high level while hiding implementation details. It was used, among other things, in the implementation of a highly reliable Ada compiler (NYU Ada/ED), and its influence extended to later language design as well—for example, Lambert Meertens carried SETL's set-oriented ideas into ABC, which in turn influenced Python.
summary_en: SETL is positioned as a historical language whose role has largely ended, and it is essentially unused in new development today. However, its set-theoretic ideas were carried into the ABC language by Lambert Meertens, indirectly leaving their mark on the design of features such as Python's comprehensions, and it is remembered as an important milestone in the history of language design.

name: Unicon
problem: 文字列・リスト処理に強いIcon言語は、1990年代当時、OSファイルシステムやネットワーク、データベースへのアクセス、オブジェクト指向プログラミングの機能が乏しく、実用的なアプリケーション開発には不向きだった。Clint Jefferyらは、OO拡張のIdol、POSIXファイル・ネットワークインターフェース、ODBCデータベース機能というIconの3つの人気拡張を統合し、Iconの高水準な文字列・パターン処理能力を保ちながらグラフィックスやネットワークを扱えるUniconを開発した。
summary: Icon言語にオブジェクト指向とOS・ネットワーク・DB連携機能を統合した後継言語。
problem_en: Icon, a language strong at string and list processing, lacked, as of the 1990s, adequate access to OS file systems, networking, and databases, as well as object-oriented programming features, making it ill-suited for practical application development. Clint Jeffery and colleagues integrated Icon's three popular extensions—the OO extension Idol, a POSIX file/network interface, and ODBC database functionality—to create Unicon, which could handle graphics and networking while retaining Icon's high-level string and pattern-processing capabilities.
summary_en: Unicon is positioned as a niche language and has not achieved widespread adoption, but as Icon's successor it continues to be developed and used by a small community interested in text processing and prototyping.

name: SISAL
problem: 1980年代初頭、科学技術計算では複数プロセッサを持つ並列計算機が普及し始めたが、FortranやCのような命令型言語ではロックや同期を伴う並列プログラミングの記述・デバッグが難しかった。ローレンス・リバモア国立研究所やマンチェスター大学などの共同チームは、単一代入(single assignment)とデータフローの原理に基づく関数型言語SISALを設計し、副作用を排除することでコンパイラが自動的かつ安全に並列化できるようにした。前身のVALに再帰と有限ストリームを追加し、Fortranに匹敵する実行性能を目指した。
summary: 副作用のない単一代入・データフロー原理により自動並列化を可能にした、科学技術計算向け関数型言語。
problem_en: In the early 1980s, parallel computers with multiple processors were beginning to spread in scientific and technical computing, but writing and debugging parallel programs involving locks and synchronization was difficult in imperative languages such as Fortran and C. A joint team from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, the University of Manchester, and others designed SISAL, a functional language based on the principles of single assignment and dataflow, eliminating side effects so that the compiler could automatically and safely parallelize programs. It added recursion and finite streams to its predecessor, VAL, aiming for execution performance comparable to Fortran.
summary_en: SISAL is positioned as a historical language whose role has largely ended, and it is rarely adopted in new projects today. However, its idea of automatic parallelization based on the principles of single assignment and dataflow continues to be referenced as an important precursor in later research on parallel and functional languages.

name: Lucid
problem: 当時主流だったフォン・ノイマン型の逐次実行モデルでは、可変変数と副作用を前提とするためプログラムの検証や並列化が難しいという課題があった。Ashcroft と Wadge は、変数を無限のデータストリームとして扱い、宣言的な等式でプログラムを記述するデータフロー型言語Lucidを考案し、非フォン・ノイマン型の計算モデルを実験的に探求した。要求駆動(demand-driven)の評価方式を採用し、必要な値だけを計算することで、明示的な代入なしに時間や状態変化を表現できるようにした。後にSISAL、Lustre、Pure Dataなどのデータフロー言語の設計に影響を与えた。
summary: 変数を無限ストリームとして扱う、非フォン・ノイマン型のデータフロープログラミング言語。
problem_en: In the sequential, von Neumann-style execution model that dominated at the time, the reliance on mutable variables and side effects made it difficult to verify programs or parallelize them. Ashcroft and Wadge devised Lucid, a dataflow language in which variables are treated as infinite data streams and programs are written as declarative equations, as an experimental exploration of a non-von-Neumann computational model. It adopted a demand-driven evaluation strategy that computed only the values actually needed, making it possible to express time and changes of state without explicit assignment. Lucid later influenced the design of dataflow languages such as SISAL, Lustre, and Pure Data.
summary_en: Lucid was never widely used for practical application development and remains a niche language. However, its idea of treating variables as infinite streams became the theoretical foundation for later dataflow and synchronous languages such as SISAL and Lustre, giving it lasting significance as a research language. It is still occasionally referenced in research on computational models.

name: Linda
problem: 1980年代、並列・分散計算が普及し始める中、プロセス間通信を簡潔かつ移植性高く記述する方法が求められていた。Gelernterは既存の並列言語が煩雑で扱いにくいと考え、計算そのものを記述する言語とは独立した「座標言語(coordination language)」としてLindaを設計した。共有の「タプル空間」にデータを出し入れする少数の操作(out, in, rd, evalなど)だけでプロセス同士を疎結合に連携させることを可能にした。この設計により、既存のホスト言語(C、Fortranなど)にLindaのモデルを組み込むだけで並列処理機能を追加できるようになった。
summary: 共有タプル空間を介してプロセスを疎結合に連携させる並行コーディネーション言語。
problem_en: In the 1980s, as parallel and distributed computing began to spread, there was a need for ways to express inter-process communication concisely and portably. Gelernter felt that existing parallel languages were cumbersome and hard to work with, and designed Linda as a "coordination language" kept separate from whatever language described the computation itself. It made it possible to loosely couple processes together using only a small number of operations (`out`, `in`, `rd`, `eval`, and so on) that put data into and take it out of a shared "tuple space." This design meant parallel processing capability could be added simply by embedding the Linda model into an existing host language such as C or Fortran.
summary_en: Linda never became widely adopted as a specific practical system and remains a niche presence today. However, its idea of a loosely coupled concurrency model built around a tuple space left its mark on the design philosophy of later distributed computing technologies such as JavaSpaces, and it is still cited in theoretical discussions of concurrent computation.

name: Turing
problem: 1980年代初頭、大学の初学者向けプログラミング教育では、Pascalなど既存言語の複雑な構文規則が学習の妨げになっていた。トロント大学のRic HoltとJames Cordyは、Pascal、Euclid、SP/kでの経験を踏まえ、読みやすく学びやすい構文を持つ教育用言語Turingを設計した。セミコロンを不要にし、明示的な終端キーワード(end ifなど)を用いることで、初心者が構造を理解しやすいコードを書けるようにした。オンタリオ州の高校を中心に広く採用され、教育用言語として大きな役割を果たした。
summary: 初学者向けに読みやすい構文を追求した教育用の手続き型・オブジェクト指向言語。
problem_en: In the early 1980s, introductory university programming education was hampered by the complex syntax rules of existing languages such as Pascal. Ric Holt and James Cordy of the University of Toronto drew on their experience with Pascal, Euclid, and SP/k to design Turing, an educational language with syntax intended to be easy to read and easy to learn. By eliminating the need for semicolons and using explicit terminating keywords (such as `end if`), they made it possible for beginners to write code whose structure was easy to understand. Turing was adopted widely in high schools in Ontario and played a major role as an educational language.
summary_en: Turing has long been used mainly as an educational language in Canadian schools, particularly in Ontario, and its use today remains centered on education. It never saw wide adoption in commercial or industrial settings, and is positioned as a language specialized for educational purposes.

name: COMAL
problem: 1970年代、教育現場で広く使われていたBASICは対話的で学びやすい一方、GOTO文中心の非構造的なコードになりやすく、いわゆる「スパゲティコード」を生みやすいという問題があった。デンマークの数学教師Børge Christensenは、BASICの手軽さとPascalの構造化プログラミングの利点を組み合わせた言語としてCOMALを設計した。IF...THEN...ENDIFやPROC...ENDPROCといったブロック構造を導入し、行番号やGOTOに頼らない読みやすいコードを書けるようにした。8ビットパソコン時代の教育用言語として北欧や英国の学校で普及した。
summary: BASICの手軽さとPascalの構造化プログラミングを融合させた教育用言語。
problem_en: In the 1970s, BASIC, widely used in education at the time, was interactive and easy to learn, but tended to produce unstructured code centered on GOTO statements — the kind of code known as "spaghetti code." Danish mathematics teacher Børge Christensen designed COMAL as a language combining the ease of BASIC with the benefits of Pascal's structured programming. By introducing block structures such as `IF...THEN...ENDIF` and `PROC...ENDPROC`, it made it possible to write readable code without relying on line numbers or GOTO. It spread through schools in the Nordic countries and the UK as an educational language of the 8-bit home computer era.
summary_en: COMAL is still positioned today as an educational language, continuing to be used in some educational settings and enthusiast communities as material for teaching the fundamentals of structured programming. It is almost never newly adopted for commercial or industrial use, but is historically valued as an educational language that bridged BASIC and structured programming.

name: Argus
problem: 1980年代、分散システムでは複数のマシン上で動くプログラムの障害耐性や一貫性の保証が大きな課題であった。MITのBarbara Liskovらは、自身が設計したCLU言語を拡張し、分散プログラムを堅牢に構築するための言語Argusを開発した。関連する手続きをカプセル化する「ガーディアン」と呼ばれるオブジェクトと、原子性を保証する「アクション」という概念を導入し、部分的な障害が発生してもデータの一貫性を保てる仕組みを提供した。この研究は後の分散システムやトランザクション処理の言語設計に影響を与えた。
summary: ガーディアンとアトミックなアクションにより堅牢な分散プログラムの構築を支援した研究用言語。
problem_en: In the 1980s, a major challenge in distributed systems was guaranteeing the fault tolerance and consistency of programs running across multiple machines. Barbara Liskov and colleagues at MIT extended the CLU language they had designed to create Argus, a language for building robust distributed programs. They introduced objects called "guardians" that encapsulate related procedures, along with a concept called "actions" that guarantee atomicity, providing a mechanism that kept data consistent even in the face of partial failures. This work influenced later language design for distributed systems and transaction processing.
summary_en: Argus never saw wide use as a practical programming language and is now regarded as a historical language whose research role has ended. Concepts such as guardians and atomic actions went on to influence later research into distributed transaction processing systems and RPC design, and it continues to be cited as an important case study in the history of distributed systems research.

name: MAD
problem: 1950年代末、IBM 704などの初期の科学技術計算ではFORTRANやCOBOLは存在したものの、より簡潔で使いやすいプログラミング手段が求められていた。ミシガン大学のBernard Galler、Bruce Arden、Robert M. Grahamは、ALGOL 58(IAL)の考え方を出発点にしつつも大きく異なる独自設計により、MAD(Michigan Algorithm Decoder)を開発した。高速なコンパイルと分かりやすい構文により、1960年代を通じて多くの大学でプログラミング教育に用いられた。MADはCTSS、Multics、Michigan Terminal Systemの開発にも使われ、初期のELIZAチャットボットもMAD-SLIPで書かれた。
summary: ミシガン大学で開発され、1960年代の大学教育で広く使われた手続き型言語。
problem_en: In the late 1950s, although FORTRAN and COBOL already existed for early scientific and technical computing on machines such as the IBM 704, there was demand for a simpler and easier-to-use programming tool. Bernard Galler, Bruce Arden, and Robert M. Graham of the University of Michigan developed MAD (Michigan Algorithm Decoder), taking ALGOL 58 (IAL) as a starting point but arriving at a substantially different, original design. Thanks to its fast compilation and easy-to-understand syntax, it was used for programming education at many universities throughout the 1960s. MAD was also used in the development of CTSS, Multics, and the Michigan Terminal System, and the early ELIZA chatbot was written in MAD-SLIP.
summary_en: MAD played an important role in university education and systems development in the 1960s, but its practical role ended as FORTRAN, C, and other languages later became widespread, and it is now regarded as a historical language. Its use in early operating system development and artificial intelligence research is still referenced today from the standpoint of the history of computer science.

name: Emerald
problem: 1980年代、分散システム上でオブジェクトを移動・配置しながら性能を保つプログラミング言語が不足していた。ワシントン大学の研究者らは、Pascal・Simula・Smalltalkの流れを汲みつつ、オブジェクトの移動性(mobility)と位置透過性を第一級の概念として組み込むことを目指した。情報隠蔽を保ちながら分散プログラミングを簡潔に書けることも重視された。小さく実用的な言語として設計され、後のJavaや分散OS研究にも影響を与えた。
summary: 分散システム向けにオブジェクトの移動性と位置透過性を重視して設計されたオブジェクト指向言語。
problem_en: In the 1980s, there was a shortage of programming languages that could move and place objects across a distributed system while preserving performance. Researchers at the University of Washington, building on the lineage of Pascal, Simula, and Smalltalk, aimed to build object mobility and location transparency into the language as first-class concepts. Equal emphasis was placed on being able to write distributed programs concisely while preserving information hiding. Designed as a small, practical language, it went on to influence later work on Java and distributed operating systems research.
summary_en: Emerald is positioned as a historical language and is not used in production today. However, its idea of distributed object mobility is said to have indirectly influenced later work on Java and research into distributed operating systems.

name: Concurrent Pascal
problem: 1970年代前半、共有メモリ型コンピュータ上でOSやリアルタイム監視プログラムのような並行処理プログラムを安全に記述する高水準言語が存在しなかった。Per Brinch HansenはPascalをベースに、モニタ(monitor)という同期・排他制御の概念を導入し、プロセス間通信を構造化された形で記述できるようにした。DEC PDP-11向けの実装を通じて、安全な並行プログラミングの理論と実践の基礎を築いた。
summary: Pascalにモニタによる並行処理機構を組み込んだ、OS記述を目的とする初期の並行プログラミング言語。
problem_en: In the early 1970s, no high-level language existed for safely writing concurrent programs—such as operating systems or real-time monitoring programs—on shared-memory computers. Per Brinch Hansen built on Pascal to introduce the concept of the monitor, a mechanism for synchronization and mutual exclusion, making it possible to write inter-process communication in a structured form. Through an implementation for the DEC PDP-11, it laid the theoretical and practical groundwork for safe concurrent programming.
summary_en: Concurrent Pascal is a historical language and is not in actual use today. However, its idea of synchronization via monitors is said to have left a substantial mark on later concurrent programming languages and OS theory.

name: JOVIAL
problem: 1950年代末、軍用の組込みシステムや航空機の電子機器向けにリアルタイム処理を行える高水準言語がほとんど存在しなかった。System Development CorporationのJules Schwartzらは、ALGOL 58とSAGE防空システム開発の経験を基に、実時間・組込み用途に適した言語JOVIALを設計した。米空軍の航空機ソフトウェア開発を中心に採用され、事務処理向けではなく制御システム向けに最適化されている。
summary: 軍事・航空宇宙分野のリアルタイム組込みシステム向けに設計されたALGOL系の初期言語。
problem_en: At the end of the 1950s, there was almost no high-level language capable of real-time processing for military embedded systems or aircraft electronics. Jules Schwartz and colleagues at the System Development Corporation, drawing on ALGOL 58 and their experience developing the SAGE air-defense system, designed JOVIAL as a language suited to real-time and embedded use. It was adopted mainly for U.S. Air Force aircraft software development, and is optimized for control systems rather than business data processing.
summary_en: JOVIAL is positioned as a legacy language, and is said to still be used today for maintaining some older military and aerospace systems. It is almost never used for new development, but retains a historical presence in long-lived, mission-critical systems.

name: Dyalog APL
problem: 1980年代当時、APLの実装は主に高価な大型機向けであり、マイクロコンピュータや台頭しつつあったUnix系システムで動作する手頃な価格の処理系が求められていた。Dyalog社はKenneth IversonのAPLの配列指向の表現力を保ちながら、より広範なプラットフォームで動作する商用APL処理系を開発した。その後、オブジェクト指向や関数型プログラミング、名前空間などの現代的な機能を取り入れ、金融・保険・データ分析分野の実務用途に対応してきた。
summary: 金融・データ分析分野で広く使われる、現代的拡張を備えた商用APL処理系。
problem_en: At the time, in the 1980s, implementations of APL ran mainly on expensive mainframes, and there was demand for an affordable implementation that would run on microcomputers and the then-emerging Unix-family systems. Dyalog developed a commercial APL implementation that preserved the array-oriented expressiveness of Kenneth Iverson's APL while running on a broader range of platforms. It has since incorporated modern features such as object orientation, functional programming, and namespaces, and has served practical use in finance, insurance, and data analysis.
summary_en: Dyalog APL is positioned as an active language, and continues to see real-world use today, particularly in finance, insurance, and data analysis. Thanks to ongoing development by Dyalog and community activity, it is among the most actively used implementations within the APL family today.

name: Q (kdb+)
problem: 2000年代初頭、金融業界では大量の時系列(ティック)データを高速に取り込み分析する必要があったが、既存のSQL系データベースでは性能や表現力が不十分だった。Arthur Whitneyは自身が設計したK言語をベースに、列指向でインメモリ・ディスク双方を扱えるデータベースkdb+と、それを操作するための読みやすいクエリ言語Qを開発した。ビッド・アスク価格の照合など、金融時系列分析に最適化されている。
summary: kdb+データベースを操作する、金融の時系列分析に特化した配列・関数型クエリ言語。
problem_en: In the early 2000s, the finance industry needed to ingest and analyze huge volumes of time-series (tick) data at high speed, but existing SQL-family databases lacked the performance and expressiveness required. Building on the K language he had himself designed, Arthur Whitney developed kdb+, a columnar database capable of handling both in-memory and on-disk data, along with Q, a readable query language for operating on it. It is optimized for financial time-series analysis, including tasks such as matching bid and ask prices.
summary_en: Q is positioned as a niche language, remaining in persistent use in specific areas such as tick-data analysis and algorithmic trading systems within the finance industry. Its adoption as a general-purpose language has been limited, but its performance advantages within its target domain make it hard to replace.

name: Shakti
problem: kdb+/Qの開発から十数年を経て、Arthur Whitneyはマルチコア・大規模並列環境での性能とメモリ効率をさらに追求する次世代の配列言語を必要とした。K言語の設計思想を継承しつつ、大規模データセットに対する高い並列性と省メモリ性を実現することを目指して開発された。金融分析など大量データ処理を要する分野での利用を想定している。
summary: Arthur WhitneyがK言語の後継として開発した、並列処理性能を重視する配列プログラミング言語。
problem_en: More than a decade after developing kdb+/Q, Arthur Whitney needed a next-generation array language that would push performance and memory efficiency further on multi-core, large-scale parallel environments. It was developed to carry forward the design philosophy of the K language while achieving high parallelism and low memory usage on large datasets. It is intended for use in fields requiring heavy data processing, such as financial analysis.
summary_en: Shakti is positioned as a niche language, used in a limited set of specialized fields such as large-scale data processing and financial analysis, as a successor within the K-family lineage. It has not achieved widespread general-purpose adoption, but continues to draw attention as an implementation carrying forward Arthur Whitney's design philosophy.

name: Nial
problem: 1970年代後半、カナダのクイーンズ大学のMike Jenkinsは、Trenchard Moreの配列理論を実用的なプログラミング言語として実装することを目指した。当時のAPLは強力な配列演算を持つ一方で記号処理や入れ子構造データの表現が苦手であり、Lispは記号処理に優れるが配列演算が弱いという課題があった。Nialはこの両者の長所を組み合わせ、数値・文字・記号データを統一的な配列として扱える構造化言語として設計された。主に人工知能研究やアルゴリズムのプロトタイピング用途を想定していた。
summary: 配列理論に基づき、APL的な配列演算とLisp的な記号処理を統合した多目的プロトタイピング言語。
problem_en: In the late 1970s, Mike Jenkins of Queen's University in Canada set out to implement Trenchard More's array theory as a practical programming language. APL at the time had powerful array operations but was weak at symbolic processing and representing nested data structures, while Lisp excelled at symbolic processing but had weak array operations. Nial was designed to combine the strengths of both, as a structured language that treats numeric, character, and symbolic data uniformly as arrays. It was intended primarily for artificial intelligence research and algorithm prototyping.
summary_en: Nial is currently positioned as a niche-use language. It continues to be used in some circles as an experimental vehicle for AI research and algorithm description, but it has not achieved widespread adoption as a general-purpose practical language.

name: Koka
problem: Microsoft ResearchのDaan Leijenは、純粋関数型言語が副作用の扱いで表現力に欠ける一方、命令型言語では副作用が型に現れず挙動が予測しにくいという課題に着目した。Kokaは行多相(row-polymorphic)なエフェクト型システムを導入し、関数がどのような副作用を起こしうるかを型シグネチャで明示できるようにした。さらに代数的エフェクトハンドラにより、例外処理・状態・非同期処理などを統一的かつ合成可能な形で記述できることを目指した。Perceusと呼ばれる参照カウント最適化により、ガベージコレクタなしで関数型コードを高速実行することも狙いとしている。
summary: 副作用を型システムで明示的に追跡する、代数的エフェクトとハンドラを備えた研究用関数型言語。
problem_en: Daan Leijen of Microsoft Research focused on the problem that pure functional languages lack expressiveness in handling side effects, while imperative languages leave side effects invisible in their types, making behavior hard to predict. Koka introduced a row-polymorphic effect type system that lets a function's type signature explicitly state what side effects it may cause. It further aimed, through algebraic effect handlers, to let exception handling, state, and asynchronous processing be described in a unified and composable way. Through a reference-counting optimization called Perceus, it also aims to run functional code efficiently without a garbage collector.
summary_en: Koka is currently positioned as a niche research language. It continues to draw attention in programming language theory, particularly in research on effect systems and algebraic effects, but it has not achieved widespread adoption as a practical language.

name: Grain
problem: Philip BlairとOscar Spencerは、HaskellやOCamlのような学術的関数型言語が持つ強力な型システムやパターンマッチングなどの機能が、難解さゆえに一般の開発者に広く使われていない現状に問題意識を持った。Grainは、WebAssemblyという新しい実行基盤をターゲットにしつつ、静的型付けによる実行時型エラーの排除と親しみやすい構文を両立させることを目指して設計された。JavaScriptエコシステムとの親和性を保ちながら、関数型言語の恩恵をより多くの開発者に届けることを狙いとしている。
summary: WebAssemblyを実行基盤とし、学術的な関数型言語の機能を親しみやすい構文で提供する言語。
problem_en: Philip Blair and Oscar Spencer took issue with the fact that features of academic functional languages such as Haskell and OCaml—powerful type systems, pattern matching, and the like—were, because of their perceived difficulty, not widely used by mainstream developers. Grain was designed to target WebAssembly as a new execution platform, while aiming to combine the elimination of runtime type errors through static typing with an approachable syntax. It aims to bring the benefits of functional languages to a wider range of developers while maintaining affinity with the JavaScript ecosystem.
summary_en: Grain is currently positioned as a niche-use language. Development continues as one of the experimental options among WebAssembly-targeted languages, but it has not achieved widespread adoption as a practical language.

name: Inko
problem: オランダの開発者Yorick Peterseは、ErlangやPonyのようなアクターベースの言語から着想を得つつ、並行プログラムにおける予測不能な性能劣化・実行時エラー・データ競合といった問題を解決することを目指してInkoを開発した。Inkoは軽量プロセスによる並行モデルを採用し、単一所有権に基づく決定的な自動メモリ管理によってガベージコレクタなしで安全な並行処理を実現する。静的型付けとエラーハンドリング機構により、型安全な並行処理と信頼性の高いソフトウェア開発を可能にすることを狙いとしている。
summary: 単一所有権による決定的メモリ管理で、データ競合のない並行処理を実現する静的型付け言語。
problem_en: The Dutch developer Yorick Peterse drew inspiration from actor-based languages such as Erlang and Pony, and developed Inko aiming to solve problems in concurrent programs such as unpredictable performance degradation, runtime errors, and data races. Inko adopts a concurrency model based on lightweight processes, and achieves safe concurrency without a garbage collector through deterministic automatic memory management based on single ownership. Through static typing and an error-handling mechanism, it aims to enable type-safe concurrency and reliable software development.
summary_en: Inko is currently positioned as a niche-use language. Development continues as an experimental effort in language design aimed at achieving safe concurrency, but it has not achieved widespread adoption as a practical language.

name: Futhark
problem: コペンハーゲン大学DIKUのTroels Henriksen、Cosmin Oancea、Martin Elsmanらは、GPUなど大規模並列ハードウェア向けのプログラムを、CUDAやOpenCLを直接書くことなく高性能に記述する方法を模索した。Futharkは関数型のデータ並列プログラミングスタイルを採用し、コンパイラが高度な融合最適化を行うことで、手書きの並列コードに匹敵する性能の実現を目指す。単体の汎用言語としてではなく、既存アプリケーションに組み込む計算カーネルを生成するためのツールとして設計されている。
summary: GPU向け高性能計算カーネルを関数型データ並列スタイルで記述できる配列言語。
problem_en: Troels Henriksen, Cosmin Oancea, Martin Elsman and others at DIKU, University of Copenhagen, sought a way to write high-performance programs for massively parallel hardware such as GPUs without writing CUDA or OpenCL directly. Futhark adopts a functional data-parallel programming style, aiming to achieve performance comparable to hand-written parallel code by having the compiler perform advanced fusion optimizations. Rather than being designed as a standalone general-purpose language, it is designed as a tool for generating computational kernels to be embedded into existing applications.
summary_en: Futhark is currently positioned as a niche-use language. It continues to be used, as a research and practical tool for generating high-performance computational kernels for GPUs, in parts of the scientific computing field.

name: Bosque
problem: Microsoft ResearchのMark Marronは、1970年代以降主流となった構造化プログラミングモデル(ループ、可変状態、参照の同一性など)が、コードの自動的な推論や検証を困難にしていると考えた。Bosqueは、TypeScriptに似た親しみやすい構文とNode/JavaScriptのような書き味を保ちながら、意味論としてはMLのような関数型言語の性質を取り入れ、複雑さの温床となる要素を排除する「規則化されたプログラミング」を目指して設計された。SMTソルバーによるプロパティ検証や高信頼性・クラウドネイティブなソフトウェア開発を見据えた次世代の中間表現とツール群の研究も目的としていた。プロジェクトは2023年11月にMicrosoftのリポジトリとしてはアーカイブされている。
summary: ループや可変状態を排除し、自動検証を容易にする実験的な関数型スタイル言語。
problem_en: Mark Marron of Microsoft Research believed that the structured programming model that became mainstream from the 1970s onward (loops, mutable state, reference identity, and the like) made automated reasoning about and verification of code difficult. Bosque was designed to keep an approachable syntax similar to TypeScript and a coding feel similar to Node/JavaScript, while adopting functional-language semantics akin to ML, aiming for a "regularized programming" that eliminates the elements that breed complexity. It also aimed at research into property verification via SMT solvers and a next-generation intermediate representation and tooling geared toward highly reliable, cloud-native software development. The project was archived as a Microsoft repository in November 2023.
summary_en: Bosque was archived as a Microsoft repository in November 2023, and is positioned as a research project that has finished its historical role. As an experimental attempt at "regularized programming" that eliminates loops and mutable state, it left behind certain insights for the field of programming language research.

name: Verona
problem: クラウド環境で動作するソフトウェアではメモリ安全性の欠陥が信頼性を損なう深刻な脅威となっていた。VeronaはMicrosoft Researchが開発した実験的言語で、所有権の概念を新しい並行処理モデルと統合し、ロックなしに安全な並行メモリアクセスを実現しようとしている。オブジェクトを不変・孤立可変・共有などの領域に分類し、コンパイラが並行変更を静的に防ぐ設計を採用する。Pony言語の共同設計者であるSylvan Clebschらが中心となり、アクターモデルと所有権型を組み合わせた並行性モデルを模索している。現在も研究段階であり、大規模なリファクタリングが継続中の実験的プロジェクトである。
summary: 所有権と並行性を統合した、Microsoft Researchによるクラウド向け実験的システム言語。
problem_en: In software running in cloud environments, memory-safety flaws had become a serious threat undermining reliability. Verona is an experimental language developed by Microsoft Research that attempts to achieve safe concurrent memory access without locks by integrating the concept of ownership with a new concurrency model. It classifies objects into regions such as immutable, isolated-mutable, and shared, with a design in which the compiler statically prevents unsafe concurrent mutation. Led by Sylvan Clebsch, a co-designer of the Pony language, the project explores a concurrency model that combines the actor model with ownership types. It remains at the research stage today, an experimental project undergoing continuous, large-scale refactoring.
summary_en: Niche. Verona remains an experimental, research-stage language undergoing continuous large-scale refactoring. Practical adoption is still limited, but the forward-looking design that reconciles concurrency with memory safety has drawn interest from language researchers and cloud-systems developers.

name: Austral
problem: システムプログラミング言語では、メモリ安全性を保証する既存手法(ガベージコレクションや複雑な借用チェッカー)の複雑さやオーバーヘッドが課題となっていた。Australは線形型を採用することで、リソースの二重解放や解放後使用といったバグをコンパイル時に排除しつつ、言語仕様自体を一人の人間が理解できるほど単純に保つことを目指して設計された。また、モジュールごとに外部リソースへのアクセス権限を制限する能力ベースのセキュリティモデルを備え、サプライチェーン攻撃のリスク低減も意図している。設計者のFernando BorrettiはAdaのモジュールシステムとRustの線形型・借用の概念を土台に、Haskellの型クラスや代数的データ型のような関数型的機能も取り入れた。
summary: 線形型による安全なリソース管理とシンプルさを重視した実験的システムプログラミング言語。
problem_en: In systems programming languages, the complexity and overhead of existing techniques for guaranteeing memory safety—garbage collection or elaborate borrow checkers—had become a persistent challenge. Austral was designed to eliminate bugs such as double-free and use-after-free at compile time by adopting linear types, while keeping the language specification itself simple enough for a single person to fully understand. It also features a capability-based security model that restricts each module's access to external resources on a per-module basis, intended to reduce the risk of supply-chain attacks. Designer Fernando Borretti built on Ada's module system and Rust's concepts of linear types and borrowing, while also incorporating functional features such as Haskell-style type classes and algebraic data types.
summary_en: Niche. Austral is used by a small community of developers as an experimental systems programming language, and its design philosophy—pursuing safety and simplicity through linear types—continues to draw attention.

name: Vale
problem: システムプログラミングでは、ガベージコレクションによる実行時オーバーヘッドと、Rustの借用チェッカーがもたらす学習コストや制約の高さがトレードオフとして立ちはだかっていた。Valeは「世代参照」という独自の仕組みにより、ガベージコレクションも複雑な借用チェッカーも使わずにメモリ安全性を実現しようとしている。将来的には領域ベースの借用チェックを導入し、安全性を保ったまま高速化を図る計画である。設計者のEvan Ovadiaは、以前に開発していた言語Gelでの制約参照の経験を踏まえてValeを設計した。現在はアルファ版の段階にあり、コミュニティによる開発が続けられている。
summary: 世代参照によりGCも借用チェッカーも使わずにメモリ安全性を実現しようとする実験的システム言語。
problem_en: In systems programming, a trade-off stood in the way: the runtime overhead of garbage collection on one side, and the steep learning curve and constraints imposed by Rust's borrow checker on the other. Vale attempts to achieve memory safety through a mechanism of its own called "generational references," without relying on either garbage collection or a complex borrow checker. It plans to eventually introduce region-based borrow checking to further improve performance while preserving safety. Designer Evan Ovadia drew on his experience with constraint references from his earlier language, Gel, in designing Vale. The language is currently at the alpha stage, with development ongoing within its community.
summary_en: Niche. Vale is still at the alpha stage, with development continuing within its community. Its ambitious goal of achieving memory safety without garbage collection or a borrow checker has drawn attention from those interested in systems-language design.

name: Gren
problem: Elmはシンプルで安全なフロントエンド関数型言語として支持を集めていたが、開発体制がほぼ単独の作者に依存しており、コミュニティの要望が言語仕様になかなか反映されないという不満があった。Grenはこうした状況を受けてElmからフォークされ、コミュニティ主導で継続的に言語を進化させることを目的として作られた。副作用やエラー処理を型システムで管理する純粋関数型のアプローチをElmから引き継ぎつつ、配列操作の改善やNode.js対応など独自の拡張を加えている。2024年からは単独開発者体制を離れ、コアチームによる開発体制に移行した。
summary: コミュニティ主導の継続的発展を目指してElmからフォークされた純粋関数型言語。
problem_en: Elm had gained support as a simple, safe functional language for front-end development, but its development was dependent on essentially a single author, leading to dissatisfaction that community requests were slow to be reflected in the language specification. Gren was forked from Elm in response to this situation, with the goal of evolving the language continuously under community-driven governance. It carries over Elm's pure functional approach of managing side effects and error handling through the type system, while adding its own extensions such as improved array operations and support for Node.js. Since 2024 it has moved away from a single-developer model to a core-team-based development structure.
summary_en: Niche. As a fork of Elm, Gren continues to be developed under community-driven governance. Adoption has grown mainly among those dissatisfied with Elm's community governance, but its user base remains limited.

name: Hylo
problem: システムプログラミングでは、安全性とパフォーマンスを両立させるためにRustのような借用チェッカーが広く用いられてきたが、その学習コストの高さやエイリアシング制約の複雑さが課題視されていた。Hylo(旧称Val)は、参照ではなく値そのものの意味論(mutable value semantics)を核とすることで、借用チェッカーを使わずにメモリ安全性と高速性を両立させることを狙って設計された。Dave AbrahamsやDimi Racordonらが中心となり、Swiftのサブスクリプトの仕組み、C++のSTLに見られる汎用プログラミングの知見、Rustの借用の概念を参考にしている。双方向連結リストのように従来は参照セマンティクスでしか安全に書けなかったデータ構造も、値セマンティクスによって安全かつ高速に実装できることを目指している。
summary: 値意味論と汎用プログラミングにより借用チェッカー無しの安全性を追求する実験的システム言語(旧Val)。
problem_en: In systems programming, borrow checkers such as Rust's had come into wide use to reconcile safety with performance, but their steep learning curve and the complexity of their aliasing constraints were seen as a problem. Hylo (formerly named Val) was designed around the idea of "mutable value semantics"—the semantics of values themselves rather than references—aiming to achieve both memory safety and high performance without a borrow checker. Led by Dave Abrahams and Dimi Racordon, the project draws on Swift's subscript mechanism, the generic-programming insights found in C++'s STL, and Rust's concept of borrowing. It aims to let data structures such as doubly linked lists, which traditionally could only be written safely under reference semantics, be implemented safely and efficiently using value semantics instead.
summary_en: Niche. Hylo continues to be developed as an experimental systems programming language, and its approach of achieving safety and speed through value semantics, without a borrow checker, has drawn attention from researchers and language enthusiasts.

name: Halide
problem: 画像処理プログラムは、アルゴリズムのロジックとループ順序・並列化・ベクトル化といった実行スケジュールの詳細が密結合しており、性能チューニングのたびにコード全体を書き換える必要があった。Halideは MITのJonathan Ragan-KellyとAndrew Adamsらによって開発され、画像処理パイプラインの「アルゴリズム」と「スケジュール」を明確に分離することでこの問題を解決した。開発者はまずアルゴリズムを宣言的に記述し、その後スケジュールだけを変更することで、コードを書き直さずに様々なハードウェア向けに性能を最適化できる。C++に組み込まれるDSLとして実装されており、GoogleのPixelシリーズやAdobe Photoshopなど産業界で広く採用されている。
summary: アルゴリズムと実行スケジュールを分離することで画像処理パイプラインの最適化を容易にするC++組み込みDSL。
problem_en: In image-processing programs, the algorithm's logic had been tightly coupled with the details of its execution schedule—loop order, parallelization, vectorization—so that any performance tuning required rewriting the entire program. Halide, developed by Jonathan Ragan-Kelley and Andrew Adams at MIT, solved this problem by clearly separating an image-processing pipeline's "algorithm" from its "schedule." A developer first writes the algorithm declaratively, and can then optimize performance for a variety of hardware targets simply by changing the schedule, without rewriting the code. Implemented as a DSL embedded in C++, it has been widely adopted in industry, including in Google's Pixel camera pipeline and Adobe Photoshop.
summary_en: Active. Halide is in wide practical use across industry—including at Google and Adobe—in image processing and computational photography, and it stands as one of the representative DSLs referenced in compiler-optimization research.

name: ISPC
problem: CPUのSIMD(ベクトル)命令を活用するには、従来はコンパイラの自動ベクトル化に頼るか、煩雑なSIMDイントリンシクスを手書きする必要があり生産性が低かった。IntelのMatt PharrらはLarrabeeプロジェクトでの経験から、GPUのSPMD(Single Program, Multiple Data)モデルをCPU向けに応用したプログラミングモデルを構想した。ISPCはC言語に似た文法でSPMDプログラムを記述し、コンパイラがそれをCPUのSIMDレーンへ自動的にマッピングすることで予測可能かつ高速なベクトル並列コードを実現する。ゲームエンジンやレンダラーなど、高性能なCPU並列処理が求められる分野で採用されている。
summary: IntelがCPUのSIMD並列処理をC言語風の文法で書けるようにしたSPMD方式のコンパイラ言語。
problem_en: Making use of a CPU's SIMD (vector) instructions traditionally meant either relying on a compiler's automatic vectorization or hand-writing cumbersome SIMD intrinsics, both of which hurt productivity. Drawing on his experience with Intel's Larrabee project, Matt Pharr envisioned a programming model that adapted the GPU's SPMD (Single Program, Multiple Data) model for use on the CPU. ISPC lets programmers write SPMD programs in a C-like syntax, and the compiler automatically maps them onto the CPU's SIMD lanes, yielding vectorized parallel code that is both predictable and fast. It has been adopted in fields that demand high-performance CPU parallelism, such as game engines and renderers.
summary_en: ISPC is an active language, with development continuing at Intel. It sees practical use in fields that demand high-performance SIMD parallelism on the CPU, such as game engines and rendering engines.

name: HLSL
problem: DirectX初期の時代、頂点シェーダーやピクセルシェーダーはGPUのアセンブリ言語で直接記述する必要があり、開発効率が悪く保守も困難だった。MicrosoftはDirectX 9のリリースに合わせて、C言語に似た高水準の文法でGPUシェーダーを記述できるHLSLを開発した。同時期にNVIDIAが開発したCgと設計面で多くを共有しており、両者はほぼ同一の言語として登場した経緯がある。ハードウェアに依存しない高水準表現とコンパイラによる最適化を両立させ、シェーダー開発の生産性を大きく向上させた。
summary: MicrosoftがDirectX向けに開発した、GPUシェーダーをC言語風の文法で記述する高水準シェーディング言語。
problem_en: In the early days of DirectX, vertex and pixel shaders had to be written directly in GPU assembly language, which made development inefficient and maintenance difficult. To coincide with the release of DirectX 9, Microsoft developed HLSL, which let GPU shaders be written in a high-level, C-like syntax. It shared much of its design with Cg, developed around the same time by NVIDIA, and the two languages emerged as near-identical siblings. By combining hardware-independent high-level expression with compiler-driven optimization, HLSL greatly improved the productivity of shader development.
summary_en: HLSL is an active language and continues to be widely used as the standard shading language of the DirectX and Windows graphics ecosystem. It plays a central role in real-time graphics fields, game development chief among them.

name: WGSL
problem: 従来のWeb向けグラフィックスAPIであるWebGLはGLSL ESをシェーダー言語として用いていたが、より新しいネイティブグラフィックスAPI(Vulkan/Metal/Direct3D 12)相当の機能をブラウザで安全に提供する次世代API WebGPUには、ブラウザのサンドボックス要件を満たす新しいシェーダー言語が必要だった。W3CのGPU for the Webワーキンググループは、未定義動作を避け静的検証を強化した安全性重視の言語としてWGSLを設計した。構文はRustの影響を強く受けつつ、GLSLやHLSLといった既存シェーダー言語の概念も踏まえている。複数のGPUバックエンドに移植可能で、決定論的な実行を保証することを目指している。
summary: WebGPU向けにW3Cが標準化した、安全性と静的検証を重視する次世代シェーディング言語。
problem_en: The existing web graphics API, WebGL, used GLSL ES as its shading language, but WebGPU — the next-generation API meant to safely expose functionality comparable to newer native graphics APIs (Vulkan/Metal/Direct3D 12) inside the browser — needed a new shading language that could satisfy the browser's sandboxing requirements. The W3C's GPU for the Web working group designed WGSL as a safety-focused language that avoids undefined behavior and emphasizes static verification. Its syntax is strongly influenced by Rust, while also drawing on concepts from existing shading languages such as GLSL and HLSL. It is designed to be portable across multiple GPU backends and to guarantee deterministic execution.
summary_en: WGSL is an active language, and standardization continues at the W3C as part of the WebGPU specification. Implementation in major browsers is progressing, and it is increasingly used as the standard shading language for next-generation graphics and GPGPU programming on the web.

name: Taichi
problem: Pythonは書きやすい反面、物理シミュレーションや疎な(スパースな)データ構造を扱う計算では実行速度が大きな課題となっていた。MIT出身のYuanming HuらはPythonに埋め込みつつJITコンパイルによりGPU/CPUで高速実行できる言語としてTaichiを開発した。特に疎なボクセルグリッドなど空間的に疎なデータ構造の扱いや、微分可能プログラミングによる物理ベース機械学習への応用を意識して設計されている。計算内容とスケジューリングを分離するHalide的なアプローチを参考にしつつ、Pythonのシンプルな文法を維持している。
summary: Pythonに埋め込み、GPU/CPUで高速な物理シミュレーションを可能にする並列計算言語。
problem_en: Python is easy to write, but execution speed had long been a serious problem for computations involving physical simulation or sparse data structures. Yuanming Hu, an MIT alumnus, and colleagues developed Taichi as a language embedded in Python that could nonetheless be JIT-compiled for fast execution on GPU or CPU. It was designed with particular attention to handling spatially sparse data structures, such as sparse voxel grids, and to applications in physics-based machine learning through differentiable programming. It draws on a Halide-like approach that separates computation from scheduling, while retaining Python's simple syntax.
summary_en: Taichi is an active language, seeing continued heavy use in research and development involving physical simulation, computer graphics, and machine learning. Development by its open-source community also continues.

name: Cg
problem: 2000年代初頭、GPUのシェーダープログラミングはアセンブリ言語での記述が中心であり、開発者にとって学習・保守のコストが高い状態だった。NVIDIAはWilliam R. MarkらがC言語やRenderManシェーディング言語を参考に、C言語に似た文法でグラフィックスハードウェアをプログラムできるCgを開発した。CgはMicrosoftのHLSLと設計面で多くを共有しており、ほぼ同時期に登場した姉妹言語だった。しかし2012年にNVIDIAが開発を終了し、その後はOpenGL標準のGLSLやMicrosoftのHLSLにシェーダー言語の主流の座を譲った。
summary: NVIDIAが開発した、C言語風の文法でGPUシェーダーを記述する初期の高水準シェーディング言語。
problem_en: In the early 2000s, GPU shader programming was still centered on writing assembly language, imposing a high learning and maintenance cost on developers. Drawing on C and the RenderMan shading language, William R. Mark and colleagues at NVIDIA developed Cg, which let graphics hardware be programmed in a C-like syntax. Cg shared much of its design with Microsoft's HLSL, and the two emerged as sister languages at almost the same time. However, NVIDIA ended development of Cg in 2012, after which GLSL (the OpenGL standard) and Microsoft's HLSL took over as the dominant shading languages.
summary_en: Cg is a historical language; NVIDIA ended its development in 2012. Today, GLSL (the OpenGL standard) and Microsoft's HLSL are the dominant shading languages, and Cg survives only in old documentation and legacy projects.

name: CUE
problem: Googleは社内のクラスタ管理システムBorgなどの設定管理にGCLやBCLといった独自言語を使っていたが、構文の複雑化や検証の難しさといった課題を抱えていた。Google出身のMarcel van Lohuizenはこれらの経験を踏まえ、型と値を統一的に扱う制約ベースの言語としてCUEを設計し、2019年にオープンソース化した。CUEはデータ検証・設定管理・スキーマ定義・コード生成など複数の用途を単一の言語で扱えることを目指している。Kubernetes関連のクラウドネイティブな設定管理ツール(DaggerやTimoniなど)で採用が進んでいる。
summary: Googleでの設定管理言語の経験を踏まえて設計された、データ検証と設定管理のための宣言的言語。
problem_en: Google used in-house languages such as GCL and BCL for configuration management in systems like its internal cluster manager, Borg, but these suffered from growing syntactic complexity and difficulty of validation. Drawing on this experience, Marcel van Lohuizen, a Google alumnus, designed CUE as a constraint-based language that treats types and values uniformly, and open-sourced it in 2019. CUE aims to handle multiple use cases — data validation, configuration management, schema definition, and code generation — within a single language. It has seen growing adoption in cloud-native configuration management tools related to Kubernetes, such as Dagger and Timoni.
summary_en: CUE is an active language, with growing adoption as a configuration management and data validation language within the cloud-native ecosystem. Backed by its track record originating at Google, its use continues to grow, particularly around Kubernetes-related tools.

name: Pkl
problem: JSONやYAMLなどの静的な設定フォーマットは、システムが複雑化するにつれて検証機能の欠如や重複防止ができないという限界に直面していた。また設定を汎用プログラミング言語のDSLとして実装すると、特定の言語エコシステムに縛られる問題もあった。Appleは、クラスや関数、静的型による検証といったプログラミング言語の機能を備えつつ、JSON・YAML・XML・plistなど複数のフォーマットへ出力できる専用の設定言語としてPklを開発した。これにより、大規模なアプリケーション設定やインフラ定義を安全かつ再利用可能な形で記述できることを目指した。
summary: Appleが開発した、静的型と検証機能を備えたJSON/YAML代替の設定記述言語。
problem_en: Static configuration formats such as JSON and YAML ran into fundamental limits as systems grew more complex: they lacked validation capabilities and offered no way to avoid duplication. An alternative approach—embedding configuration as a DSL within a general-purpose programming language—had also been tried, but that tied the configuration to a specific language ecosystem. Apple developed Pkl as a dedicated configuration language that combines programming-language-like features such as classes, functions, and static-type validation with the ability to emit multiple output formats including JSON, YAML, XML, and plist. The goal was to let large-scale application configuration and infrastructure definitions be written in a way that is both safe and reusable.
summary_en: Pkl is a language that only appeared in 2024. Apple uses it internally for its own application configuration and infrastructure definitions while also publishing it as open source. As an active language, it is in the process of gaining adoption as a type-safe alternative to JSON/YAML for configuration authoring.

name: Cairo
problem: Ethereum上のオンチェーン計算はガス代が高く処理能力にも限界があった。StarkWareは、計算を安価に検証可能にするSTARK証明を用いてオフチェーンで重い計算を行い、その正当性のみをオンチェーンで検証するZKロールアップ方式のスケーリングを実現しようとした。しかし従来は算術回路や多項式制約を手作業で構築する必要があり開発が困難だった。Cairoは証明可能なプログラムを記述できる初のチューリング完全な言語として設計され、開発者が通常の言語のような感覚でSTARK証明可能なプログラムやStarkNetのスマートコントラクトを書けるようにした。Cairo 1.0ではRustに影響を受けた構文へ刷新された。
summary: StarkWareが開発した、STARK証明可能なプログラムを記述するチューリング完全な言語。StarkNetのスマートコントラクト記述に使われる。
problem_en: On-chain computation on Ethereum was expensive in gas fees and limited in processing capacity. StarkWare sought to achieve scaling through a ZK-rollup approach: heavy computation would be performed off-chain, with only its correctness verified on-chain, using STARK proofs that make computation cheaply verifiable. Previously, however, this required manually constructing arithmetic circuits and polynomial constraints, which made development difficult. Cairo was designed as the first Turing-complete language capable of expressing provable programs, letting developers write STARK-provable programs and StarkNet smart contracts with the feel of an ordinary programming language. With Cairo 1.0, the syntax was overhauled to be influenced by Rust.
summary_en: Cairo continues to be actively developed and used as the smart-contract language for StarkNet. As a language at the core of ZK-rollup blockchain-scaling technology, it continues to evolve alongside the STARK proof ecosystem.

name: Michelson
problem: 2016年のThe DAO事件に代表されるように、スマートコントラクトのバグは取り返しのつかない金銭的損失につながる恐れがあった。Tezosは、こうしたリスクを減らすため形式検証になじみやすいスマートコントラクト言語を必要としていた。Michelsonは、Forth・Scheme・ML・Catといった複数の言語系統からアイデアを取り入れ、スタックベースで副作用を持たない純粋関数型かつ静的型付けの言語として設計された。型付けされたプログラムは実行前に検証されるため、スタック形状の不整合などによる実行時エラーが原理的に発生しない。
summary: Tezosのスマートコントラクト向けに設計された、スタックベースで形式検証を前提とした静的型付け言語。
problem_en: As typified by the 2016 DAO incident, bugs in smart contracts could lead to irrecoverable financial losses. Tezos needed a smart-contract language that was amenable to formal verification in order to reduce such risks. Michelson was designed by drawing ideas from several language lineages—Forth, Scheme, ML, and Cat—as a stack-based, side-effect-free, purely functional, and statically typed language. Because typed programs are verified before execution, runtime errors caused by things like stack-shape mismatches cannot occur in principle.
summary_en: Michelson continues to run actively as the smart-contract execution language of the Tezos blockchain. Because its design is amenable to formal verification, it is also used as a compilation target for higher-level languages such as LIGO and SmartPy.

name: Plutus
problem: Solidityに代表される従来のスマートコントラクト言語は、アカウントベースのモデルや型システムの弱さから予期しないバグや脆弱性を生みやすいという課題があった。IOHK(現IOG)は、Haskellの強力な静的型システムと関数型プログラミングの厳密さを活用し、学術的な形式手法に基づく安全なスマートコントラクト記述を可能にすることを目指した。PlutusはHaskellのサブセットとしてSystem Fωベースの低レベル言語Plutus Coreにコンパイルされ、eUTXOモデルと組み合わせることで決定的でガス代の予測しやすいコントラクト実行を実現する。2021年のAlonzoハードフォークによりCardanoメインネットで稼働を開始した。
summary: CardanoのHaskell埋め込み型スマートコントラクト言語。eUTXOモデルと組み合わせ、形式手法に基づく安全性を重視する。
problem_en: Conventional smart-contract languages typified by Solidity had a tendency toward unexpected bugs and vulnerabilities, stemming from account-based models and weak type systems. IOHK (now IOG) sought to leverage Haskell's powerful static type system and the rigor of functional programming to enable safe smart-contract authoring grounded in academic formal methods. Plutus, designed as a subset of Haskell, compiles to Plutus Core, a low-level System-Fω-based language, and combines with the eUTXO model to achieve deterministic contract execution with predictable gas costs. It began operating on the Cardano mainnet with the Alonzo hard fork in 2021.
summary_en: Plutus is actively used as the smart-contract language of the Cardano blockchain. Since the Alonzo hard fork in 2021, it has continued to serve as the central language for smart-contract development in the Cardano ecosystem.

name: Clarity
problem: Solidity/EVM上のスマートコントラクトでは、再入(リエントランシー)攻撃やガス切れによる予測不能な停止など、実行時に初めて判明する問題が多発していた。Blockstack(現Hiro Systems)は、コントラクトの挙動やコストを実行前に静的解析できる言語を目指し、あえてチューリング完全性を捨てた設計を採用した。ClarityはLisp系のS式構文を持ち、ソースコードを直接インタプリタで解釈実行するためコンパイラに起因するバグの余地がなく、ソースコード自体が正しさの仕様となる。BitcoinをアンカーとするStacksブロックチェーン上で、Bitcoinの状態を直接参照できる点も特徴である。
summary: Stacks(Bitcoinレイヤー)向けの、あえてチューリング非完全とした決定可能なLisp系スマートコントラクト言語。
