problem_en: Smart contracts on Solidity/EVM suffered repeatedly from problems that only became apparent at runtime, such as reentrancy attacks and unpredictable halts due to running out of gas. Blockstack (now Hiro Systems) aimed for a language whose behavior and cost could be statically analyzed before execution, and deliberately adopted a design that gives up Turing completeness. Clarity has a Lisp-style S-expression syntax and is interpreted directly from source without compilation, leaving no room for compiler-induced bugs, so the source code itself serves as the specification of correctness. It also runs on the Stacks blockchain, which is anchored to Bitcoin, and can reference Bitcoin state directly.
summary_en: Clarity continues to be actively used as the smart-contract language of the Stacks blockchain, a Bitcoin layer. Its design philosophy of prioritizing predictability through non-Turing-completeness sets it apart from other smart-contract languages.

name: Scilla
problem: Ethereumのスマートコントラクトでは、整数オーバーフローや再入攻撃など言語設計に起因する脆弱性が繰り返し問題となっていた。Zilliqaブロックチェーン向けに開発されたScillaは、こうした脆弱性を言語レベルで排除し、形式検証になじむ中間レベル言語として設計された。コントラクトを状態遷移を行うオートマトンとしてモデル化し、副作用のない純粋な計算部分とメッセージによる通信部分を明確に分離することで、証明支援系Coqを用いた形式的意味論の検証を可能にしている。学術研究(Sergey, Kumar, Hobor, 2018年)を出発点に開発されたが、2025年にはGitHubリポジトリがアーカイブされ開発は縮小している。
summary: Zilliqa向けの、計算と通信を分離したオートマトンベースの形式検証指向スマートコントラクト中間言語。
problem_en: Ethereum smart contracts repeatedly suffered from vulnerabilities rooted in language design, such as integer overflow and reentrancy attacks. Scilla, developed for the Zilliqa blockchain, was designed as an intermediate-level language that eliminates such vulnerabilities at the language level and is amenable to formal verification. By modeling contracts as automata that perform state transitions, and by clearly separating the side-effect-free pure computation part from the message-based communication part, it enables the verification of formal semantics using the Coq proof assistant. It was developed starting from academic research (Sergey, Kumar, and Hobor, 2018), but by 2025 its GitHub repository had been archived and development had scaled back.
summary_en: Scilla was developed as the smart-contract language of the Zilliqa blockchain, but by 2025 its GitHub repository had been archived and development had effectively scaled back. While its design philosophy emphasizing formal verification retains academic significance, in practical operation it is winding down the role it once played.

name: Cypher
problem: グラフデータベースNeo4jにおいて、ノードと関係(エッジ)として表現された相互接続データを効率的に問い合わせる手段が必要とされた。従来のSQLはテーブル指向で結合が多いグラフ探索には不向きであり、パターンマッチングに適した専用言語が求められた。Andrés Taylorらは、SQLの読みやすさを保ちながら、括弧と矢印でノードと関係を視覚的に表現できる構文を設計した。これによりMATCH句でグラフパターンを直感的に記述できるようになった。後にopenCypherとして公開され、ISO標準GQLの基盤にもなった。
summary: Neo4j向けに開発された、ノードと関係をASCIIアート風の構文でパターンマッチングする宣言的グラフクエリ言語。
problem_en: The Neo4j graph database needed an efficient way to query interconnected data represented as nodes and relationships (edges). Conventional SQL was designed around tables and joins, which made it poorly suited to the kind of traversal that graph structures require. Andrés Taylor set out to design a new syntax that preserved SQL's readability while letting nodes and relationships be expressed visually through parentheses and arrows. The result was a language in which graph patterns could be written intuitively using a MATCH clause. Cypher was later released as openCypher and went on to form the basis of the ISO GQL (Graph Query Language) standard.
summary_en: Cypher is an actively used language today (status: active), remaining widely used in the graph database field, centered on Neo4j. Its openCypher specification has also been incorporated into the drafting of the ISO GQL standard, giving it an important role in the standardization of graph queries.

name: Gremlin
problem: グラフデータベースやグラフ処理エンジンが乱立する中、ベンダーごとに異なるクエリ言語を学ぶ必要があるという課題があった。Apache TinkerPopプロジェクトは、OLTP型のグラフデータベースとOLAP型のグラフ処理系の両方で動作する統一的なグラフトラバーサル言語を必要としていた。Marko A. Rodriguezは、命令型と宣言型の両方のスタイルでグラフを走査できる言語としてGremlinを設計した。これによりJava、Python、Groovyなど複数言語から同じトラバーサル概念でグラフを操作できるようになった。
summary: 複数のグラフデータベース・処理系に対応する、命令型と宣言型を併せ持つ汎用グラフトラバーサル言語。
wikipedia_ja: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/グレムリン_%28プログラミング言語%29
problem_en: With graph databases and graph processing engines proliferating, developers faced the burden of learning a different query language for every product. The Apache TinkerPop project needed a unified graph traversal language that could run against both OLTP-style graph databases and OLAP-style graph processing systems. Marko A. Rodriguez designed Gremlin as a language capable of traversing graphs in both imperative and declarative styles. This made it possible to manipulate graphs using a shared traversal concept from multiple host languages, including Java, Python, and Groovy.
summary_en: Gremlin occupies a niche position (status: niche), remaining in use in graph databases such as JanusGraph that adopt the Apache TinkerPop ecosystem. In the graph query field it has been somewhat overshadowed by Cypher and GQL, but it retains support among users who value its generality across multiple graph engines.

name: KQL (Kusto Query Language)
problem: Microsoftは自社のクラウドサービスで発生する大量のログやテレメトリデータを、低遅延かつ高スケーラビリティで分析する必要に迫られていた。従来のリレーショナルデータベース向けSQLは、時系列データやテキスト検索を多用する分析ワークロードに最適化されていなかった。そこでAzure Data Explorer(開発コード名Kusto)のために、パイプ演算子でデータをテーブルから段階的に絞り込んでいく新しいクエリ言語が設計された。SQLに似た概念を持ちながら、読みやすさと分析効率を重視した構文になっている。
summary: Azure Data Explorer向けに開発された、パイプ演算子でログやテレメトリを段階的に分析する宣言的クエリ言語。
problem_en: Microsoft needed to analyze, with low latency and at high scale, the enormous volume of logs and telemetry data generated by its own cloud services. Conventional SQL for relational databases was not optimized for analytical workloads that make heavy use of time-series data and text search. So a new query language was designed for Azure Data Explorer (development codename Kusto) in which a pipe operator progressively narrows data down from a table. It retains concepts similar to SQL while placing extra emphasis on readability and analytical efficiency.
summary_en: KQL is an actively used language today (status: active), remaining a standard query language across Microsoft's cloud monitoring and security product family, including Azure Data Explorer, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft Sentinel.

name: PromQL
problem: SoundCloudでは、コンテナ化が進むインフラの監視にStatsDやGraphiteといった既存ツールでは不十分となっていた。多次元的なラベル付きメトリクスを収集し、それをリアルタイムに集計・アラート判定できる強力なクエリ言語が必要とされた。Matt T. ProudとJulius Volzは、Googleの内部監視システムBorgmonの考え方を参考にしつつ、Prometheus向けの時系列データ専用の関数型クエリ言語としてPromQLを設計した。多次元データモデルと組み合わせることで、運用のシンプルさと強力な集計表現力を両立させた。
summary: 監視システムPrometheus向けに設計された、ラベル付き時系列メトリクスをリアルタイムに集計する関数型クエリ言語。
problem_en: At SoundCloud, existing monitoring tools such as StatsD and Graphite could no longer keep up with monitoring an increasingly containerized infrastructure. What was needed was a powerful query language capable of collecting multi-dimensional, labeled metrics and aggregating and evaluating alert conditions against them in real time. Drawing on ideas from Google's internal monitoring system Borgmon, Matt T. Proud and Julius Volz designed PromQL as a functional query language dedicated to the time-series data of Prometheus. Combined with its multi-dimensional data model, it achieves both operational simplicity and powerful aggregation expressiveness.
summary_en: PromQL is an actively used language today (status: active), remaining, in effect, the standard query language across the cloud-native monitoring ecosystem centered on Prometheus. It occupies a particularly important position in monitoring and alerting for Kubernetes environments.

name: GraphQL
problem: Facebookのモバイルアプリでは、REST APIから必要以上のデータを取得する(オーバーフェッチ)、または複数回のリクエストが必要になる(アンダーフェッチ)という非効率が問題になっていた。クライアントごとに異なるデータ要求に対応する固定的なエンドポイントの管理コストも増大していた。Lee Byron、Nick Schrock、Dan Schaferらは、クライアントが必要なデータ構造を宣言的に指定して取得できるクエリ言語としてGraphQLを開発した。2012年に開発が始まり、2015年にオープンソースとして公開され、REST APIに代わるAPI設計の標準として広く採用されるようになった。
summary: Facebookが開発した、クライアントが必要なデータ構造を宣言的に指定して取得できるAPIクエリ言語。
problem_en: Facebook's mobile apps suffered from the inefficiency of "over-fetching" more data than needed from REST APIs, or conversely "under-fetching," which required multiple requests. The number of endpoints kept growing to accommodate the differing data needs of each client, and the cost of managing them kept rising along with it. Lee Byron, Nick Schrock, and Dan Schafer developed GraphQL as a query language that lets a client declaratively specify the exact data structure it needs and fetch it in one go. Development began internally in 2012, and after GraphQL was released as open source in 2015, it was rapidly adopted as a standard for API design in place of REST.
summary_en: GraphQL is an actively used language today (status: active), widely adopted in web and mobile application development as an alternative to REST APIs. Many companies, including GitHub and Shopify, publish GraphQL APIs, and its ecosystem continues to expand.

name: Natural
problem: Software AGは、自社のADABASデータベースをメインフレーム上でより生産性高く操作するためのプログラミング言語を必要としていた。当時主流だったCOBOLは記述が冗長で開発効率に課題があり、より少ないコードでビジネスアプリケーションを構築できる第4世代言語(4GL)が求められた。Naturalは画面入出力機能を内蔵し、対話的な開発とバッチ処理の両方に対応する言語として設計された。COBOLの競合として登場し、後にはJavaと並ぶサービス記述言語としても位置づけられるようになった。
summary: Software AGがADABASデータベース向けに開発した、COBOLより生産性の高い第4世代プログラミング言語。
problem_en: Software AG needed a programming language for operating its own ADABAS database on mainframes with greater productivity. COBOL, the dominant language of the time, was verbose to write and posed challenges for development efficiency, creating demand for a fourth-generation language (4GL) that could build business applications with far less code. Natural was designed with built-in screen input/output facilities, supporting both interactive development and batch processing. It emerged as a competitor to COBOL, and in later years came to be positioned alongside Java as a service-description language as well.
summary_en: Natural is positioned as a legacy language today (status: legacy), but it still runs in core systems at financial and insurance companies that continue to rely on ADABAS, and demand for its maintenance and migration continues. New development in the language is rarely seen, but given the scale of its existing installed base, maintenance is expected to continue for the foreseeable future.

name: Progress ABL (OpenEdge)
problem: 1980年代初頭、企業向け業務アプリケーションはメインフレーム向けのCOBOLやUNIXミニコン向けのCなど専門知識を要する言語で開発されており、開発コストと期間が大きな課題だった。Progress社はアーキテクチャに依存しない4GLとデータベースを統合したプラットフォームを提供することで、コンピュータ科学の専門家でない業務担当者でも迅速にビジネスアプリケーションを構築できるようにすることを目指した。IBM PCなど安価なハードウェアの普及に伴い、多様な環境で動く統一開発基盤への需要にも応えた。後にOpenEdge ABLとしてオブジェクト指向機能も取り込み、現在も企業システムで現役利用されている。
summary: データベース統合型の4GLとして企業向け業務アプリケーション開発を簡易化したProgress社の言語。
problem_en: In the early 1980s, enterprise business applications were developed in specialist languages such as COBOL for mainframes and C for UNIX minicomputers, and the cost and time required for development were a major challenge. Progress Software Corporation aimed to provide an architecture-independent platform integrating a 4GL with a database, enabling business staff without computer science expertise to quickly build business applications. As inexpensive hardware such as the IBM PC spread, this also answered the demand for a unified development foundation that could run across diverse environments. The language later incorporated object-oriented features as OpenEdge ABL and remains in active use in enterprise systems today.
summary_en: It is active, and remains widely used today in core enterprise business systems across finance, manufacturing, and government. It continues to be maintained and extended by Progress Software Corporation as the OpenEdge platform.

name: PowerBuilder
problem: 1980年代末からMicrosoft Windowsの普及に伴い、グラフィカルユーザーインターフェースを持つ業務アプリケーションへの需要が急速に高まったが、当時の開発手法は生産性が低かった。Powersoft社はデータベースアクセスを抽象化する独自のDataWindowコンポーネントを核とした、迅速なアプリケーション開発(RAD)ツールを開発した。これによりデータベースベンダー間の差異を意識せずにデータ入出力画面を効率的に構築できるようになった。金融・製造・行政分野の基幹業務システムで現在も広く使われ続けている。
summary: DataWindowによるデータベースアプリケーション開発を効率化したオブジェクト指向RADツール。
problem_en: From the late 1980s, as Microsoft Windows spread, demand rapidly grew for business applications with graphical user interfaces, but development methods of the time offered low productivity. Powersoft Corporation developed a rapid application development (RAD) tool centered on its own DataWindow component, which abstracted database access. This made it possible to efficiently build data input and output screens without needing to be aware of differences between database vendors. It remains widely used today in core business systems in finance, manufacturing, and government.
summary_en: It is active, and remains widely used today in core business systems in finance, manufacturing, and government. Its continued use is sustained by strong demand for maintaining the large body of existing applications built up over the years.

name: Clarion
problem: 1980年代半ば、IBM PC上でデータベース業務アプリケーションを開発する際、当時の低水準言語では画面設計やメモリ管理が煩雑で開発効率が低いという課題があった。Bruce Barringtonは、コンパクトで表現力の高い言語仕様と、PCのメモリマップド画面を最大限活用する画面デザイナーを統合することを目指した。Pascal系の構造化プログラミングの影響を受けつつ、4GLとしての統合開発環境を提供することでデータベースアプリ開発を簡素化した。現在もSoftVelocity社により保守され、ニッチな業務システム分野で使われ続けている。
summary: IBM PC向けにデータベース業務アプリ開発を簡素化したPascal系の4GL言語。
problem_en: In the mid-1980s, developing database business applications on the IBM PC with the low-level languages of the time made screen design and memory management cumbersome, resulting in low development efficiency. Bruce Barrington aimed to integrate a compact, expressive language specification with a screen designer that made full use of the PC's memory-mapped screen. Influenced by Pascal-style structured programming, Clarion simplified database application development by providing an integrated 4GL development environment. It continues to be maintained by SoftVelocity today and remains in use in a niche segment of business systems.
summary_en: It occupies a niche position; while SoftVelocity continues to maintain it today, its use is confined to specific segments of business systems.

name: Magic (4GL)
problem: 1980年代初頭、業務アプリケーションの開発にはコンパイルとリンクを伴う煩雑なプロセスが必要で、開発サイクルが長期化しがちだった。Magic Software Enterprisesは、コンパイルやリンクを必要とせず即座にデバッグ可能な、メタデータ駆動型のアプリケーション生成方式を採用した。開発者はロジックをコーディングする代わりに設定(メタデータ)を定義するだけで業務アプリケーションを構築できるようになった。この手法はマルチプラットフォーム対応のビジネスアプリ開発を高速化し、後継のMagic xpaプラットフォームへと発展した。
summary: コンパイル不要のメタデータ駆動型アプローチで業務アプリ開発を高速化した4GL。
problem_en: In the early 1980s, developing business applications required a cumbersome process involving compiling and linking, which tended to lengthen development cycles. Magic Software Enterprises adopted a metadata-driven application generation approach that required no compiling or linking and could be debugged immediately. Instead of coding logic, developers could build business applications simply by defining configuration (metadata). This approach accelerated the development of multi-platform business applications and evolved into the later Magic xpa platform.
summary_en: It occupies a niche position; it continues to be used in specific business system domains, having evolved into the successor Magic xpa platform.

name: GNU Octave
problem: 1980年代後半、化学反応装置設計の授業の補助教材として、行列・ベクトル演算を伴う数値計算を行う無償のツールが必要とされたことがOctave誕生のきっかけだった。当時MATLABのような商用数値計算ソフトウェアは高価で、教育機関や個人が自由に利用することが難しいという課題があった。John W. EatonはMATLABとの高い互換性を持つ言語仕様を採用しつつ、GPLのもとで自由に利用・改変できるフリーソフトウェアとして開発した。これにより数値解析・科学技術計算の民主化に貢献し、現在も学術・産業分野で広く使われている。
summary: MATLAB互換の無償な数値計算言語として教育目的から生まれたGNUプロジェクトの一つ。
problem_en: Octave originated from the need, in the late 1980s, for a free tool capable of performing numerical computation involving matrix and vector operations, as supplementary material for a course on chemical reactor design. At the time, commercial numerical computing software such as MATLAB was expensive, making it difficult for educational institutions and individuals to use it freely. John W. Eaton adopted a language specification highly compatible with MATLAB while developing it as free software that could be freely used and modified under the GPL. This contributed to the democratization of numerical analysis and scientific computing, and it remains widely used in academia and industry today.
summary_en: It is active, and remains widely used today in academic research, education, and industry as a free, MATLAB-compatible numerical computing environment.

name: Scilab
designers: INRIA (フランス国立情報学自動制御研究所)
École nationale des ponts et chaussées (ENPC)
problem: 1990年前後、科学技術計算や数値シミュレーションを行うための高機能なツールはMATLABなど高価な商用ソフトウェアに限られ、研究機関が自由に利用・改変できる選択肢が乏しかった。フランスの研究機関INRIAとENPCの研究者らは、行列演算を中心とした高水準言語により、少ないコード行数で複雑な数値問題を表現できるオープンソースのプラットフォームを開発した。当初はΨlab(Psilab)と名付けられ、信号処理・統計解析・流体力学など幅広い工学分野への応用を目指した。現在はDassault Systèmesが開発を引き継ぎ、学術・産業双方で利用されている。
summary: MATLABの無償な代替として仏INRIA発で誕生したオープンソース数値計算言語。
problem_en: Around 1990, capable tools for scientific and technical computation and numerical simulation were limited to expensive commercial software such as MATLAB, leaving research institutions with few options they could freely use and modify. Researchers at the French institutions INRIA and ENPC developed an open-source platform built around a high-level, matrix-oriented language that could express complex numerical problems in relatively few lines of code. Originally named Ψlab (Psilab), it aimed at applications across a broad range of engineering fields, including signal processing, statistical analysis, and fluid dynamics. Development is now carried on by Dassault Systèmes, and it is used in both academia and industry.
summary_en: It is active; development has been carried on by Dassault Systèmes, and it continues to be used today for scientific computing and simulation in both academic research and industry.

name: GAMS
problem: 1970年代、世界銀行の経済モデリング部門では大規模な数理最適化モデルをソルバーごとに手作業で書き直す必要があり、その過程で誤りが頻発するという課題があった。GAMSはモデルの数式表現とソルバーへの入力形式を分離し、集合・パラメータ・変数・方程式からなる代数的記法でモデルを簡潔に記述できるようにした。これにより経済学者や研究者が特定のソルバーの入出力仕様を意識せずに大規模な最適化問題を定式化・保守できるようになった。線形・非線形・混合整数計画など幅広い最適化問題に対応する。
summary: 世界銀行発、数理最適化モデルを代数的記法で簡潔に記述できるモデリング言語。
problem_en: In the 1970s, the economic modeling division of the World Bank faced the problem that large-scale mathematical optimization models had to be manually rewritten for each solver, a process prone to frequent errors. GAMS separated the mathematical representation of a model from the input format required by any particular solver, allowing models to be written concisely using an algebraic notation built from sets, parameters, variables, and equations. This let economists and researchers formulate and maintain large optimization problems without needing to worry about the input/output specifications of a specific solver. It supports a wide range of optimization problem classes, including linear, nonlinear, and mixed-integer programming.
summary_en: GAMS remains an actively used language, widely applied today in economics, energy policy, agriculture, supply chain, and other fields requiring mathematical optimization modeling. It continues to be developed and maintained as a commercial product by GAMS Development Corporation.

name: AMPL
problem: AT&Tベル研究所で、大規模な線形・非線形最適化問題を数式に近い読みやすい記法で表現し、同じモデルを複数の異なるソルバーに渡せるようにする必要があった。従来の数理計画ソフトウェアはソルバー固有の入力形式に強く依存し、モデルとデータの分離が難しいという課題があった。AMPLは数学的表記に近い構文でモデルを記述し、データ定義と分離することでモデルの再利用性と保守性を高めた。nl形式を介して多数のソルバーと連携できる。
summary: 数式に近い記法で大規模最適化問題を記述できる代数モデリング言語。
problem_en: At AT&T Bell Laboratories, there was a need to express large-scale linear and nonlinear optimization problems in a readable notation close to mathematical formulas, while allowing the same model to be passed to multiple different solvers. Existing mathematical programming software depended heavily on solver-specific input formats, making it difficult to separate the model from its data. AMPL addressed this by writing models in syntax close to mathematical notation and separating them from data definitions, improving model reusability and maintainability. It can interface with numerous solvers through the nl file format.
summary_en: AMPL remains an actively used language, widely applied in large-scale mathematical optimization modeling across industry and academia. It is offered as a commercial product by AMPL Optimization, and its integration with many modern solvers continues to be maintained.

name: SPSS
problem: 1960年代、社会科学分野の研究者は統計解析を行うために自らFORTRANなどでプログラムを書く必要があり、専門的なプログラミング知識を持たない研究者にとって大きな障壁となっていた。SPSSはスタンフォード大学の大学院生らが、社会科学者自身が統計解析を行えるようにするために開発した統計解析パッケージである。コマンド構文とケース×変数の表形式データにより、専門知識がなくても多変量解析などの高度な統計処理を実行できるようにした。後にIBMに買収され、社会科学・市場調査・医療分野などで広く使われ続けている。
summary: 社会科学者が専門知識なしに統計解析を行えるようにした統計解析パッケージ。
problem_en: In the 1960s, researchers in the social sciences had to write their own programs, typically in FORTRAN, in order to perform statistical analysis—a major barrier for researchers without specialized programming knowledge. SPSS is a statistical analysis package developed by graduate students at Stanford University to let social scientists themselves carry out statistical analysis. Through its command syntax and a case-by-variable tabular data model, it made it possible to perform advanced statistical processing, including multivariate analysis, without specialized expertise. It was later acquired by IBM and continues to be widely used in the social sciences, market research, and healthcare fields.
summary_en: SPSS remains an actively used language, continuing to be widely applied as IBM SPSS Statistics in the social sciences, market research, healthcare, and education fields. Its accumulated library of statistical procedures and long-established user base keep it one of the standard choices for statistical analysis software.

name: Shen
problem: Mark Tarverは自身が設計した先行言語Qiの後継として、特定の処理系や言語に依存せず様々なホスト言語上で動く「移植可能なカーネル」という思想でShenを設計した。パターンマッチング、統合されたPrologエンジン、マクロによるDSL定義、Sequent計算に基づく静的型付けなど、複数のパラダイムを1つの言語に統合することを目指した。異なるプログラミング言語間の分断を越え、同じShenプログラムをLisp・Python・JavaScriptなど多様な言語上のカーネルで実行できることを目標とした。
summary: Lispを基盤にPrologと静的型付けを統合したポータブルな多パラダイム言語。
problem_en: Mark Tarver designed Shen as the successor to his earlier language Qi, built around the idea of a "portable kernel" that does not depend on any particular implementation or host language and can run on top of a variety of host languages. It aimed to integrate multiple paradigms into a single language: pattern matching, an integrated Prolog engine, macro-based DSL definition, and a static type system based on sequent calculus. The goal was to cross the divide between different programming languages, so that the same Shen program could run on kernels implemented in diverse host languages such as Lisp, Python, and JavaScript.
summary_en: Shen is positioned as a niche language; while it has not achieved broad adoption in practical use, it continues to be used by a segment of developers and researchers interested in its multi-paradigm design and its concept of a portable kernel.

name: Joy
problem: Manfred von ThunはJohn Backusが提唱した関数レベルプログラミング(FP)の思想を、ラムダ計算に頼らずに実現する言語を模索してJoyを設計した。Joyでは関数は仮引数を持たず、スタック上の値に対する関数合成のみでプログラムを構成する結合的(concatenative)スタイルを採用した。これによりプログラムの意味論を代数的に扱いやすくし、関数合成に基づく形式的推論がしやすい純粋関数型言語を実現した。Forthのスタックベーススタイルとの類似性(独立した収斂)や、Schemeからの影響も見られる。
summary: ラムダ計算を使わず関数合成のみでプログラムを構成する純粋関数型スタックベース言語。
problem_en: Manfred von Thun designed Joy while searching for a way to realize John Backus's ideas about function-level programming (FP) without relying on the lambda calculus. In Joy, functions take no formal parameters, and programs are built solely through function composition over values on a stack—a "concatenative" style. This made it easier to treat program semantics algebraically, producing a pure functional language well suited to formal reasoning based on function composition. It shows both a similarity to Forth's stack-based style (arrived at independently) and influence from Scheme.
summary_en: Joy is positioned as a language whose historical role has ended; it sees essentially no practical use today, but as a pioneering language that established the concatenative programming style, it continues to influence later research-oriented languages such as Cat and Kitten.

name: Cat
problem: Christopher Digginsは、Joyのような結合的(concatenative)言語が持つ簡潔さや代数的な合成のしやすさを保ちながら、静的型付けと型推論を導入した言語としてCatを設計した。従来の結合的言語の多くは動的型付けであったが、Catはスタックの入出力を高階多相型として静的に推論する仕組みを備え、変数を使わずスタック操作と引用(quotation)だけでプログラムを記述できるようにした。C#実装のv1は2008年に凍結され、後継のKittenなど静的型付き結合的言語の設計に影響を与えた。
summary: 静的型推論を備えた結合的(スタックベース)純粋関数型言語。
problem_en: Christopher Diggins designed Cat as a language that preserves the conciseness and algebraic composability of concatenative languages like Joy while introducing static typing and type inference. Whereas most earlier concatenative languages were dynamically typed, Cat introduced a mechanism for statically inferring stack inputs and outputs as higher-order polymorphic types, allowing programs to be written using only stack operations and quotations, without variables. Development of the C#-based v1 implementation was frozen in 2008, but it influenced the design of later statically typed concatenative languages such as Kitten.
summary_en: Cat is positioned as a language whose historical role has ended, with development of v1 frozen in 2008. However, its design as a statically typed concatenative language continues to influence later language designs such as Michelson and Kitten.

name: Kitten
problem: Kittenは、Forth や Factor、Joy、Cat といった連結型(concatenative)プログラミング言語の系譜を受け継ぎつつ、静的型推論による安全性と実行効率を両立させることを目指して開発された。従来の連結型言語の多くは動的型付けでガベージコレクションに依存しており、システムプログラミング用途には不向きだった。設計者のJon Purdyは、Hindley–Milner型推論をベースにした型システムと、副作用を制御するパーミッションシステム、ガベージコレクションを使わない決定的なリソース管理を組み合わせることで、簡潔で合成可能なコードと高いパフォーマンスを同時に実現しようとした。
summary: スタック指向の連結型パラダイムを採用した、静的型付けで高速なシステムプログラミング向け言語。
problem_en: Kitten was developed to carry on the lineage of concatenative programming languages such as Forth, Factor, Joy, and Cat, while combining the safety of static type inference with high execution efficiency. Most existing concatenative languages were dynamically typed and relied on garbage collection, making them poorly suited to systems programming. Designer Jon Purdy aimed to achieve both concise, composable code and high performance at once, by combining a type system based on Hindley–Milner type inference, a permission system for controlling side effects, and deterministic resource management that does not depend on garbage collection.
summary_en: Kitten is positioned as a niche language and is not widely used in practice, but its unusual design as a statically typed concatenative language continues to draw attention from developers and researchers interested in programming language theory and the concatenative paradigm.

name: ATS
problem: ATSは、実用的なプログラミングと形式的検証(定理証明)を統合することを目的として、Hongwei Xiによって設計された。C言語並みの実行速度を保ちながら、ゼロ除算やバッファオーバーフロー、メモリリークといった典型的なバグをコンパイル時に検出できる型システムの実現を目指した。静的な型検査を担う部分と実際に実行される動的な部分を明確に分離した二層構造(静的コンポーネントと動的コンポーネント)を採用している点が特徴である。学習コストの高さから普及は限定的だが、組み込みや低レベルシステム分野で安全性を重視する開発者に利用されている。
summary: 依存型と線形型により実行時オーバーヘッドなしにプログラムの安全性を形式的に検証できる関数型/命令型言語。
problem_en: ATS was designed by Hongwei Xi with the goal of unifying practical programming with formal verification (theorem proving). It aimed to realize a type system that could catch typical bugs—such as division by zero, buffer overflows, and memory leaks—at compile time, while retaining execution speed comparable to C. A distinguishing feature is its two-tiered architecture, which clearly separates the part responsible for static type checking from the part that is actually executed at runtime (the static and dynamic components). Its steep learning curve has limited widespread adoption, but it continues to be used by developers who prioritize safety in embedded and low-level systems domains.
summary_en: ATS is positioned as a niche language. While it offers advanced capabilities such as formal verification through dependent and linear types, its steep learning curve has kept it from achieving widespread adoption. It continues to be used by a subset of developers and communities who prioritize safety in embedded development and low-level systems programming.

name: NewtonScript
problem: NewtonScriptは、Apple Newtonのようなメモリ制約の厳しい携帯情報端末(当時のRAMはわずか128KB程度)上で動作させることを目的に、Walter Smithらのチームによって設計された。C++のような従来の言語ではNewtonの限られたリソースに対応できなかったため、SelfやDylanといったプロトタイプベース言語を参考にしつつ、独自の『差分継承』の仕組みを取り入れた新しい言語が必要とされた。差分継承により、GUIオブジェクトの雛形をROMに格納しデフォルトデータをRAMにコピーせずに済むなど、メモリ使用量を大幅に削減できた。1998年のNewtonプロジェクト打ち切りとともに主流の利用は終了したが、そのプロトタイプベースの設計思想はJavaScriptやIoなど後続の言語に影響を与えた。
summary: AppleのPDA『Newton』向けに開発された、差分継承を特徴とするプロトタイプベースのオブジェクト指向スクリプト言語。
problem_en: NewtonScript was designed by Walter Smith and his team to run on personal digital assistants with severe memory constraints, such as the Apple Newton, whose RAM at the time was a mere 128KB or so. Conventional languages like C++ could not cope with the Newton's limited resources, so a new language was needed—one that drew on prototype-based languages such as Self and Dylan while incorporating its own mechanism of "differential inheritance." Differential inheritance dramatically reduced memory usage, for example by storing GUI object templates in ROM without needing to copy default data into RAM. Mainstream use ended with the discontinuation of the Newton project in 1998, but its prototype-based design philosophy is said to have influenced later languages such as JavaScript and Io.
summary_en: NewtonScript is positioned as a language that has finished playing its historical role. Mainstream use ended with the discontinuation of the Apple Newton project in 1998, but its prototype-based inheritance model is said to have left a conceptual influence on the design of later languages such as JavaScript and Io.

name: Newspeak
problem: Newspeakは、Smalltalkの伝統を受け継ぎながら、より優れたモジュール性を実現することを目指してGilad Bracha(元Sun/Google)によって設計された。既存の言語の多くがグローバルな名前空間や静的な依存関係を許容していたため、コードの再利用性やテスト容易性、隔離性に課題があった。Newspeakではすべてのクラスをネストしたクラスとして扱い、外部への依存を明示的な注入によってのみ許可することで、グローバルな状態への無制御なアクセスを防ぐ設計を採用した。言語名はジョージ・オーウェルの小説『1984年』に登場する言語『ニュースピーク』に由来し、改訂のたびに言語を縮小していくという設計哲学を反映している。開発はCadence Design Systemsの支援を受けて進められたが、2009年に資金提供が終了し、その後は限定的な開発が続いている。
summary: グローバル名前空間を排除し、ネストしたクラスと依存性注入を徹底したSmalltalk系のオブジェクト指向言語。
problem_en: Newspeak was designed by Gilad Bracha (formerly of Sun/Google) with the aim of carrying on the Smalltalk tradition while achieving superior modularity. Many existing languages permitted global namespaces and static dependencies, which posed challenges for code reusability, testability, and isolation. Newspeak treats all classes as nested classes and permits dependencies on the outside world only through explicit injection, a design that prevents uncontrolled access to global state. The language's name is taken from "Newspeak," the language appearing in George Orwell's novel "1984," reflecting a design philosophy of shrinking the language with each revision. Development proceeded with support from Cadence Design Systems, but funding ended in 2009, and only limited development has continued since.
summary_en: Newspeak is positioned as a niche language. Development scaled back after funding from Cadence Design Systems ended in 2009, but its thoroughgoing modularity design, which eliminates the global namespace, remains a reference point in programming language design research.

name: Component Pascal
problem: Component Pascalは、OberonおよびOberon-2の後継として、ETH Zürich発のスピンオフ企業Oberon microsystemsによって開発された。既存のOberon-2言語の型システムをさらに洗練させ、コンポーネントソフトウェア開発に適した、より表現力豊かで安全な言語を提供することが目的だった。開発環境として提供されたBlackBox Component Builderは、フォームエディタ上でGUI部品と変数・手続きを直接結びつけて開発できる先進的な仕組みを持ち、後年の.NET開発環境の手法を先取りしていた。当初は商用製品として提供されていたが、2004〜2005年にオープンソース化され、現在は少数のボランティアコミュニティによって保守が続けられている。
summary: Oberon-2を洗練させ、コンポーネント指向のGUI開発環境BlackBoxとともに提供されたPascal系言語。
problem_en: Component Pascal was developed as a successor to Oberon and Oberon-2 by Oberon microsystems, a spin-off company from ETH Zürich. Its goal was to further refine the type system of the existing Oberon-2 language and provide a more expressive and safer language suited to component-based software development. The BlackBox Component Builder development environment provided with it featured an advanced mechanism for directly linking GUI widgets on a form editor to variables and procedures, anticipating techniques that would later appear in .NET development environments. It was initially offered as a commercial product, but was open-sourced in 2004–2005 and continues to be maintained today by a small volunteer community.
summary_en: Component Pascal is positioned as a niche language. It was formerly offered as a commercial product but has since been open-sourced and continues to be maintained by a small group of volunteers. The development approach pioneered by the BlackBox Component Builder—directly linking GUI widgets on a form to variables—is sometimes credited as a forerunner of later .NET development environments.

name: Zonnon
problem: Zonnonは、Niklaus WirthやJürg GutknechtらによるOberon言語系列の流れを汲み、実世界の並行・分散システムをより自然にモデル化することを目的にETH Zürichで設計された。従来のOberon系言語は逐次処理を前提とした設計であり、並行性や分散処理を表現するための言語機構が十分ではなかった。Zonnonでは『アクティブオブジェクト』という概念を導入し、オブジェクトが自律的な活動主体として振る舞い、構文で制御されたダイアログを通じて相互作用する統一的なモデルを提供した。また、集約によるコンポジション指向の継承の仕組みも取り入れ、オブジェクト指向とモジュール性を両立させている。.NET上で動作する実装が提供され、学術・教育目的を中心に利用されている。
summary: Oberon言語族に並行処理のための『アクティブオブジェクト』概念を導入した、ETH Zürich発の言語。
problem_en: Zonnon was designed at ETH Zürich, carrying on the lineage of the Oberon family of languages by Niklaus Wirth and Jürg Gutknecht, with the goal of more naturally modeling real-world concurrent and distributed systems. Earlier Oberon-family languages were designed on the assumption of sequential processing and lacked adequate language mechanisms for expressing concurrency and distributed processing. Zonnon introduced the concept of "active objects," providing a unified model in which objects behave as autonomous agents that interact through syntactically controlled dialogues. It also incorporated a composition-oriented approach to inheritance based on aggregation, balancing object orientation with modularity. An implementation running on .NET is provided, and the language is used mainly for academic and educational purposes.
summary_en: Zonnon is positioned as a niche language. It has not achieved widespread industrial use, but as a design that develops further the concurrency model of the Oberon family, it continues to be used for academic and educational purposes within the .NET environment.

name: NetLogo
problem: NetLogoは、プログラミング経験のない科学者や学生でも複雑系のマルチエージェントシミュレーションを構築できるようにする目的で、Uri Wilenskyがノースウェスタン大学で開発した。既存のLogoやStarLogoでは大規模な並行エージェントモデリングを直感的に記述することが難しく、教育現場と研究現場の両方で使える「敷居は低く天井は高い」言語が求められていた。タートル、パッチ、リンク、オブザーバーというエージェント概念を導入し、経済学・生物学・物理学など幅広い分野の創発現象を可視化・分析できるようにした。現在も学術研究で数千本の論文に使われるなど、教育とシミュレーション研究の両面で活用され続けている。
summary: 複雑系のマルチエージェントシミュレーションを教育・研究向けに直感的に記述できるLogo系言語。
problem_en: NetLogo was developed by Uri Wilensky at Northwestern University so that scientists and students without programming experience could build multi-agent simulations of complex systems. Existing languages such as Logo and StarLogo made it difficult to intuitively describe large-scale, concurrent agent-based modeling, and there was demand for a language with a "low floor and high ceiling" that could serve both educational and research settings. NetLogo introduced the agent concepts of turtles, patches, links, and observers, making it possible to visualize and analyze emergent phenomena across a wide range of fields including economics, biology, and physics. It continues to be used in both education and simulation research today, appearing in thousands of academic papers.
summary_en: NetLogo remains an actively used language today, continuing to see vigorous use in both academic research and education. It is used in the multi-agent simulation of complex systems in thousands of peer-reviewed papers, and it has established itself as a standard educational simulation tool. It is likely to remain one of the standard tools in the field of complex systems science going forward.

name: Etoys
problem: Etoysは、Alan KayらがXerox PARCでの研究とSeymour Papertの構築主義的教育理論をもとに、子供でも直感的にプログラミングの概念を学べる環境を作るために開発した。既存のLogoやSmalltalkは表現力に優れていたが、抽象度が高く子供が扱うには難しいという課題があった。Smalltalk実装であるSqueak上に構築し、タイル状のスクリプトでオブジェクトを操作できるビジュアルなオブジェクト指向環境として設計された。One Laptop per Childプロジェクトへの採用を通じて世界の教育現場に広まり、後のScratchにも影響を与えた。
summary: Squeak上に構築された、子供向けのビジュアルなオブジェクト指向教育用プログラミング環境。
problem_en: Etoys was developed by Alan Kay and others, drawing on their research at Xerox PARC and on Seymour Papert's constructionist theory of education, to create an environment in which even children could intuitively learn programming concepts. Existing languages such as Logo and Smalltalk were highly expressive, but they were too abstract for children to handle easily. Etoys was built on Squeak, a Smalltalk implementation, and designed as a visual object-oriented environment in which objects are manipulated through tile-based scripts. Through its adoption by the One Laptop per Child project, it spread to educational settings around the world and went on to influence the later Scratch.
summary_en: Etoys is positioned specifically for educational use and is not used for practical software development. While it no longer enjoys the reach of the former OLPC project, development continues within the Squeak/Etoys community, and it remains in use as teaching material for programming education and constructionist learning.

name: Kodu
problem: Koduは、プログラミング未経験の子供でもゲーム制作を通じてプログラミング的思考を学べるようにする目的で、Microsoft FUSE LabsのMatt MacLaurinらが開発した。テキストベースのコードは初心者にとって難解であるため、条件と行動の組み合わせで動作を記述するビジュアルなルールベース記法を採用した。3D環境でキャラクター(ボット)を動かしながらゲームを作ることで、抽象的な制御構造を体験的に学習できるようにした。Xbox 360やWindows上で動作し、作成したゲームをコミュニティで共有できる点も特徴である。
summary: 子供向けにビジュアルなルールベース記法でゲームを作りながらプログラミングを学べる教育用言語。
problem_en: Kodu was developed by Matt MacLaurin and others at Microsoft FUSE Labs so that children with no programming experience could learn computational thinking through making games. Because text-based code is hard for beginners to grasp, Kodu adopted a visual, rule-based notation that expresses behavior as combinations of conditions and actions. By having users build games while moving characters ("bots") around in a 3D environment, it allowed abstract control structures to be learned experientially. It runs on both the Xbox 360 and Windows, and another notable feature is the ability to share created games within a community.
summary_en: Kodu is positioned for educational use and is not used for commercial game development. Official active development by Microsoft has ended, but the freely released software continues to be used in some communities and in STEM education settings.

name: N88-BASIC
problem: N88-BASICは、日本電気(NEC)がPC-8800シリーズおよびPC-9800シリーズ向けに提供した標準プログラミング言語で、MicrosoftのBASICインタプリタをベースに、日本語処理やFM音源、グラフィック機能など日本の家庭用・ビジネス向けパソコンに必要な拡張を行うために開発された。ROM-BASICとして起動時に自動的に読み込まれ、当時多くの日本のパソコンユーザーが最初に触れるプログラミング言語となった。フロッピーディスクからハードディスク、MS-DOSへの移行に伴い、DISK-BASICなど機能拡張版も提供された。PC-9800シリーズの普及とともに日本国内で事実上の標準BASICとなった。
summary: NECのPC-8800/PC-9800シリーズ向けに提供された、日本語表示や周辺機器制御に対応した標準BASIC処理系。
problem_en: N88-BASIC was the standard programming language that NEC (Nippon Electric Company) supplied for its PC-8800 and PC-9800 series computers. Built on Microsoft's BASIC interpreter, it was developed to add the extensions needed for Japanese home and business personal computers, including Japanese-language handling, FM sound synthesis, and graphics capability. Loaded automatically at startup as a ROM-BASIC, it became the first programming language many Japanese personal computer users ever touched. As the platform moved from floppy disks to hard disks and then to MS-DOS, extended versions such as DISK-BASIC were also supplied. Alongside the popularity of the PC-9800 series, it became the de facto standard BASIC within Japan.
summary_en: With the decline of the PC-9800 series and the shift to MS-DOS/Windows, practical use of N88-BASIC has essentially ended, and it is positioned as a language whose historical role is over. Today it survives through use on emulators among retro-computing enthusiasts and as a subject of historical research.

name: MSX BASIC
problem: MSX BASICは、複数のメーカーが規格を統一した家庭用パソコン規格「MSX」向けに、MicrosoftとアスキーがMBASICを拡張して開発した標準BASIC処理系である。当時各社が独自仕様のパソコンとBASIC方言を乱立させていたため、規格を統一しソフトウェア資産を共有可能にすることが目的だった。グラフィック、音楽、拡張カートリッジなど、MSX規格のハードウェア機能を活用するための命令が追加された。ROMに標準搭載され起動と同時に利用できたことで、ホビイストや教育用途にも広く普及した。
summary: 統一規格MSXパソコン向けにMicrosoftとアスキーが開発した、グラフィック・音楽拡張を備えた標準BASIC。
problem_en: MSX BASIC is the standard BASIC interpreter that Microsoft and ASCII Corporation developed by extending MBASIC for "MSX," a home computer standard that unified specifications across multiple manufacturers. At the time, various manufacturers were fragmenting the market with proprietary computer specifications and BASIC dialects, and the goal was to unify the standard so that software assets could be shared. Instructions were added to take advantage of MSX-standard hardware features such as graphics, music, and expansion cartridges. Because it was built into ROM and available the moment the machine powered on, it spread widely among hobbyists and in educational settings.
summary_en: With the end of MSX computer production, its role as a practical language has ended, and it is positioned as a language whose historical role is over. Today it survives through use on emulators among retro-computing enthusiasts and as a reference for historical game development.

name: True BASIC
problem: True BASICは、BASIC言語の生みの親であるJohn KemenyとThomas Kurtzが、Microsoft BASIC系の方言が乱立する状況に対抗し、構造化プログラミングの概念とANSI標準BASICを普及させるために開発した言語である。行番号やGOTO文に依存しない構造化された記述を可能にしつつ、既存のBASICとの親和性も維持した。行列演算のネイティブサポートや、再帰を可能にするローカル変数など、教育・科学技術計算向けの機能を備えていた。ハードウェアに依存しない設計により、異なる機種間でのコードの可搬性を確保することも目指された。
summary: BASIC考案者らが構造化プログラミングとANSI標準化を目指して開発した、行列演算対応の教育・科学技術向けBASIC。
problem_en: True BASIC is a language developed by John Kemeny and Thomas Kurtz, the original creators of BASIC, to push back against the proliferation of Microsoft BASIC-family dialects and to promote the concept of structured programming together with an ANSI-standard BASIC. It enabled structured code that did not depend on line numbers or GOTO statements, while still retaining compatibility with existing BASIC. It included features aimed at education and scientific computing, such as native support for matrix operations and local variables that enabled recursion. Its hardware-independent design also aimed to ensure code portability across different machines.
summary_en: True BASIC is scarcely used today as a practical programming language and is positioned as a language whose historical role is over. Its design philosophy of pursuing standardized, structured BASIC influenced later BASIC implementations, but the language itself saw its commercial deployment shrink, and it remains in use mainly among educators and hobbyists.

name: Turbo Pascal
problem: 1980年代初頭、プログラミングにはエディタ・コンパイラ・リンカといった別々のツールを使う煩雑な作業が必要で、統合開発環境も非常に高価だった。Borland社のフィリップ・カーンは、これらの機能を一つの安価な統合開発環境(IDE)にまとめる構想を立て、Anders Hejlsbergが高速なワンパスコンパイラを中核とする処理系を実装した。49.95ドルという破格の価格と、当時の低速なマシンでも快適な編集・コンパイルサイクルを実現したことで、個人や教育機関にも本格的なPascal開発が広まった。結果としてMS-DOS時代の個人・教育向け開発環境の標準的存在となった。
summary: Borland社が低価格・高速コンパイラと統合開発環境で普及させたPascal処理系。
problem_en: In the early 1980s, programming required the cumbersome use of separate tools—an editor, a compiler, a linker—and integrated development environments were extremely expensive. Philippe Kahn of Borland conceived of bundling these functions into a single, inexpensive integrated development environment (IDE), and Anders Hejlsberg implemented a system built around an extremely fast one-pass compiler. A remarkably low price of $49.95, combined with an edit-compile cycle that felt comfortable even on the slow machines of the day, spread serious Pascal development to individuals and educational institutions alike. As a result, it became the standard development environment for individuals and education during the MS-DOS era.
summary_en: Turbo Pascal is a legacy presence and is rarely adopted for new work in current development. However, part of its design lives on today through its successor, Object Pascal (Delphi), and its historical significance in popularizing the very concept of the integrated development environment is considerable.

name: UCSD Pascal
problem: 1970年代、マイクロコンピュータや大学のミニコンピュータは機種ごとにアーキテクチャが大きく異なり、同じソースコードを様々な機種で動かすことは困難だった。UCSDのケネス・ボウルズは、乱立するハードウェアに左右されない共通の実行環境が必要と考え、仮想機械p-Systemとその上で動くPascalコンパイラ・簡易OSを開発した。ソースコードをp-codeと呼ばれる中間コードにコンパイルすることで、機種に依存しない移植性の高いプログラム実行を実現した。この設計思想は後にJavaの仮想機械にも影響を与えたとされる。
summary: p-code仮想機械により機種非依存の移植性を実現した教育・研究向けPascal環境。
problem_en: In the 1970s, microcomputers and university minicomputers varied enormously in architecture from one model to another, making it difficult to run the same source code across different machines. Kenneth Bowles at UCSD believed a common execution environment was needed—one unaffected by the proliferation of competing hardware—and developed the p-System virtual machine along with a Pascal compiler and lightweight operating system running on top of it. By compiling source code into an intermediate code called p-code, it achieved highly portable program execution independent of the underlying machine. This design philosophy is said to have later influenced the Java virtual machine as well.
summary_en: UCSD Pascal is a language whose historical role has ended, and it is not adopted for new development today. However, its design philosophy of ensuring portability through an intermediate-code virtual machine is regarded as a forerunner of ideas that later carried through to the Java virtual machine, among others.

name: Crowbar
problem: 日本のプログラマ前橋和弥は、自作の言語処理系やインタプリタを一から作る技術を学びたい人向けに、教育目的のサンプル言語としてCrowbarを開発した。yaccとlexを用いた構文解析からツリーウォーク型インタプリタの実装、ガベージコレクタやクロージャの追加まで、言語処理系の作り方を段階的に学べる教材として設計されている。文法はC言語を踏襲しつつ、動的型付けでPerlのような手軽さを持たせた。あくまで学習用サンプルであり、実用言語としての普及や高性能化を目的とはしていない。
summary: 言語処理系の作り方を学ぶための教育用サンプルスクリプト言語。
problem_en: Japanese programmer Kazuya Maebashi developed Crowbar as an educational sample language for people who want to learn the craft of building their own language processors and interpreters from scratch. It is designed as teaching material that walks learners step by step through building a language implementation—from parsing with yacc and lex, through implementing a tree-walking interpreter, to adding a garbage collector and closures. Its grammar follows C while its dynamic typing gives it Perl-like ease of use. It is purely a learning sample, and it is not intended to be adopted as a practical language or optimized for performance.
summary_en: Crowbar is positioned as a language dedicated to educational use, and it is not intended for practical application development. It continues to be referenced today, including through the book "Building a Programming Language" (プログラミング言語を作る), as introductory teaching material for building one's own language processor in the Japanese-speaking world.

name: Diksam
problem: CrowbarでインタプリタとGCの基礎を学んだ後、前橋和弥はより本格的な静的型付け・バイトコード実行型言語の作り方を教えるためにDiksamを開発した。コンパイラが生成したバイトコードを独自の仮想マシンDVM(Diksam Virtual Machine)上で実行する仕組みを持ち、Javaのクラスファイルのような重厚な仕組みを避けつつ静的型検査とバイトコード検証の考え方を学べる教材とした。boolean、int、double、stringといった基本型を持ち、関数を変数に代入できるなど関数型的な要素も取り入れている。Crowbarからの発展として、インタプリタ実装からコンパイラ・VM実装への橋渡しを行う教育目的の言語である。
summary: Crowbarの後継として作られた、静的型付け・独自VM実行を学ぶための教育用言語。
problem_en: Having taught the basics of interpreters and garbage collection with Crowbar, Kazuya Maebashi developed Diksam to teach a more full-fledged approach: how to build a statically typed, bytecode-executed language. It works by having a compiler generate bytecode that runs on a dedicated virtual machine, DVM (Diksam Virtual Machine), and it serves as teaching material for static type checking and bytecode verification while avoiding the heavyweight machinery of something like Java's class file format. It has basic types such as boolean, int, double, and string, and incorporates functional-language elements such as being able to assign functions to variables. As a progression from Crowbar, it is an educational language that bridges interpreter implementation to compiler and VM implementation.
summary_en: Diksam is a language dedicated to educational use, and it is not intended for adoption in practical application development. It continues to be referenced within the Japanese-speaking community of people building their own language processors, as teaching material for implementing a statically typed language's compiler and bytecode virtual machine.

name: Kuin
problem: 日本のプログラマ「くいなちゃん」は、HSPのような手軽さを持ちながらC++のように実用的で高性能な言語がないという課題意識からKuinを開発した。ゲーム制作や実用アプリケーション開発を主な対象とし、初心者にも分かりやすい文法としつつ、静的型付けとクラスベースのオブジェクト指向機能を備えている。代入演算子に「::」を採用するなど、行の先頭に重要な情報が来るよう配慮した独自の構文設計を行っている。日本語話者を中心としたコミュニティで利用される、継続的に開発が続くゲーム・実用向け言語である。
summary: HSPの手軽さとC++の実用性を両立させることを目指した、日本発のゲーム・実用アプリ向け言語。
problem_en: Japanese programmer "Kuina-chan" developed Kuin out of a sense that no language existed offering the ease of use of HSP while also being as practical and high-performance as C++. Aimed mainly at game development and practical application development, it combines a syntax intended to be easy for beginners with static typing and class-based object-oriented features. It adopts a distinctive syntax design—including using `::` as its assignment operator—so that important information appears at the start of each line. It is a continuously developed language for games and practical use, used mainly within a Japanese-speaking community.
summary_en: Kuin occupies a niche position, used mainly within a Japanese-speaking community for game development and hobbyist programming. Development continues, and it retains a degree of support as a language aiming to balance practicality with ease of learning.

name: 易语言 (E Language)
problem: 中国語話者にとって英語ベースのキーワードやプログラミング用語は学習の障壁となっていた。設計者の呉濤は「中国語でプログラムを書く」ことを実践するため、全ての構文・関数・キーワードを中国語で記述できる開発環境を目指した。Visual Basic的なビジュアル開発環境とライブラリ機構を取り入れ、初心者でも短期間でWindowsアプリを作れることを狙った。中国国内では教育・簡易業務アプリ開発で普及したが、海外では認知度が低く、マルウェア作成に悪用される事例も報告され評価は分かれている。
summary: 全ての構文をキーワードを中国語で記述できる、Visual Basic系の中国製ビジュアルプログラミング言語
problem_en: For Chinese speakers, English-based keywords and programming terminology were a barrier to learning. Designer Wu Tao aimed to build a development environment in which every construct, function, and keyword could be written in Chinese, in order to put into practice the idea of "writing programs in Chinese." It adopted a Visual Basic-like visual development environment and library mechanism, aiming to let even beginners build Windows applications in a short time. It became popular within China for education and for building simple business applications, but it is little known abroad, and its reputation is mixed given reports that it has also been abused to create malware.
summary_en: E Language is positioned as a niche language, and continues to be used mainly within China for education and the development of simple business applications. It is little known abroad, and its reputation is mixed, with reports that it has been abused to create malware.

name: LSE
problem: 1970年代初頭のフランスにおいて、学校教育でプログラミングを教えるための対話的でフランス語キーワードを持つ言語が必要とされた。Supélec(高等電気学校)の技術者たちが先行言語LSDを発展させ、BASICのような手軽さを持ちながら手続きや関数を最初から備えた教育用言語として設計した。1972年にフランス教育省が採用を決定し、CII Mitra 15やTélémécanique T1600などのミニコンピュータを通じてフランス国内の中等教育機関に広く展開された。
summary: フランスの中等教育向けに開発された、フランス語キーワードを用いる対話型BASIC系教育言語
problem_en: In early-1970s France, there was a need for an interactive language with French-language keywords for teaching programming in schools. Engineers at Supélec (the École Supérieure d'Électricité) developed the predecessor language LSD further, designing it as an educational language that combined BASIC-like ease of use with procedures and functions built in from the start. In 1972 the French Ministry of Education decided to adopt it, and it was widely deployed in French secondary schools via minicomputers such as the CII Mitra 15 and the Télémécanique T1600.
summary_en: LSE is a historical language that has finished its role, and it is no longer used in practice today. It is recorded in the context of educational and computing history as a language that supported the early days of computer science education in France.

name: Rockstar
problem: 技術業界で使われる「Rockstar Developer(ロックスター開発者)」という求人用語を皮肉るために作られた。開発者Dylan Beattieは、1980年代のハードロックやパワーバラードの歌詞のように読める文法を持つチューリング完全な言語を設計すれば、その文法を学ぶだけで文字通り「Rockstarのコードが書ける」と主張できる、というジョークを実現しようとした。COBOLやVisual Basicのような冗長な英語的構文の言語から着想を得ている。
summary: ロック調の歌詞のような構文でコードを書く、求人用語を皮肉ったジョークプログラミング言語
problem_en: Rockstar was created to poke fun at the "Rockstar Developer" job-listing buzzword used in the tech industry. Developer Dylan Beattie set out to realize a joke: if he designed a Turing-complete language whose grammar read like the lyrics of 1980s hard rock or power ballads, then simply learning that grammar would let someone literally claim to "write Rockstar code." It drew its inspiration from languages with verbose, English-like syntax such as COBOL and Visual Basic.
summary_en: Rockstar is positioned as a niche esoteric language and is not intended for practical use. Despite its joke origins, it has been implemented as a genuinely Turing-complete processing system, and it continues to be used in entertainment-oriented contexts such as code golf and conference demos.

name: Emojicode
problem: 従来のプログラミング言語がアルファベットの予約語や識別子を前提としていたのに対し、絵文字(emoji)そのものをキーワードや型名として使うことでプログラムを視覚的かつユーモラスに表現できないかという実験的な発想から生まれた。単なるジョークにとどまらず、オブジェクト指向、オプショナル型、ジェネリクス、クロージャ、プロトコルといった現代的な言語機能をネイティブコードにコンパイルする形で実装し、実用にも耐えうる設計を志向した点が特徴である。
summary: 絵文字をキーワードとして用いる、オブジェクト指向機能を備えたコンパイル型難解プログラミング言語
problem_en: Whereas conventional programming languages assume alphabetic reserved words and identifiers, Emojicode arose from the experimental idea of using emoji themselves as keywords and type names, to express programs in a visual and humorous way. It is more than a mere joke, however: it implements modern language features such as object orientation, optional types, generics, closures, and protocols, compiling them to native code, reflecting a design that also aimed to hold up to practical use.
summary_en: Emojicode is positioned as a niche esoteric language and is not intended for practical use. It is valued for having implemented a modern type system and object-oriented features using nothing but emoji, and it continues to draw attention among esoteric-language enthusiasts and those interested in programming language design.

name: Thue
problem: 数学者Axel Thueが考案した半チュー系(semi-Thue system)と呼ばれる文字列書き換え規則の体系を、そのままプログラミング言語として実装できないかという発想から生まれた。制御構造や変数といった通常の言語機構を持たず、非決定的な文字列置換規則の適用のみでチューリング完全性を実現する、いわゆる「チューリングの沼(Turing tarpit)」の一種として設計された。
summary: 非決定的な文字列書き換え規則のみでチューリング完全性を実現する難解プログラミング言語
problem_en: Thue arose from the idea of implementing, as-is, the system of string rewriting rules known as a semi-Thue system, devised by the mathematician Axel Thue, directly as a programming language. It has none of the usual language machinery such as control structures or variables, and was designed as a kind of "Turing tarpit" that achieves Turing completeness solely through the nondeterministic application of string substitution rules.
summary_en: Thue is positioned as a niche esoteric language and is not intended for practical use. Its theoretical purity—demonstrating Turing completeness through string rewriting alone—keeps it referenced among those with an interest in the theory of computation and esoteric languages.

name: HQ9+
problem: 多くのプログラミング言語学習で定番とされる「Hello, World!」の出力、自分自身のソースコードを出力するクワイン、再帰的な繰り返しを伴う「99 Bottles of Beer」の歌詞出力といった、お約束の課題をパロディ化するために作られたジョーク言語である。命令はH・Q・9・+のわずか4つしかなく、実用的なプログラムを書くことはできないが、新しい難解言語を作った際にこれらの定番課題が実装可能かを試す簡易な指標として使われることがある。
summary: わずか4命令で「お約束」課題をパロディ化した、実用性のないジョーク的難解プログラミング言語
problem_en: HQ9+ is a joke language created to parody the standard exercises common in learning many programming languages: printing "Hello, World!", writing a quine that outputs its own source code, and printing the lyrics of "99 Bottles of Beer" with its recursive repetition. It has only four instructions—H, Q, 9, and +—and cannot be used to write practical programs, though it is sometimes used as a quick check of whether these standard exercises can be implemented when someone creates a new esoteric language.
summary_en: HQ9+ is positioned as a niche esoteric language and is not intended for practical use. Owing to its small instruction count and joke nature, it continues to be referenced within the esoteric-language community as a point of reference for designing and comparing later languages.

name: Deadfish
problem: 難解プログラミング言語(esoteric language)の機能を極限まで削ぎ落とす実験として、HQ9+のサブセットを起点に作られた。増加・減少・二乗・出力というたった4命令だけでどこまでプログラミング言語として成立するかを試すジョーク的な言語であり、実用性は最初から意図されていない。入力機能を持たず出力に特化しており、わずか1時間程度で作られたとされる。名前は「プログラミングが腐った魚の頭を食べて臭いを嗅ぐような苦痛だ」という創作者の感想に由来する。
summary: 増加・減少・二乗・出力の4命令のみを持つ超ミニマルな難解プログラミング言語。
problem_en: Deadfish was created as an experiment to see just how far the features of an esoteric programming language could be stripped down while still remaining a "programming language." Starting from a subset of HQ9+, it is built on the joke premise of constructing a language from only four instructions: increment, decrement, square, and output. It has no input facility and is specialized purely for output, and is said to have taken only about an hour to create. Practicality was never the intent; the name comes from the designer's remark that "programming in it is as painful as smelling a rotten fish's head."
summary_en: Deadfish holds a niche position, known within the esoteric-language community as an example of just how minimal an instruction set can be while still constituting a language. It is not used for practical purposes and is mostly mentioned as a joke or an educational topic.

name: JSFuck
problem: JavaScriptの暗黙の型変換(type coercion)の柔軟性を極限まで利用し、`[ ] ( ) ! +`のわずか6文字だけで任意のJavaScriptコードを表現できることを示す目的で作られた。名称はBrainfuckに由来し、2009年のjjencodeなど既存の難読化手法の系譜を継承・発展させたもの。ブラウザのフィルタ回避やコード難読化、XSS攻撃ペイロードの生成といったセキュリティ分野での実用例がある一方、JavaScript仕様の奇妙さを示すジョーク的側面も強い。
summary: JavaScriptを6文字だけで表現する難読化・難解言語。
problem_en: JSFuck was created to demonstrate that, by exploiting the flexibility of JavaScript's implicit type coercion to its limit, arbitrary JavaScript code could be expressed using only six characters: `[ ] ( ) ! +`. The name derives from Brainfuck, and the technique inherits and extends the lineage of existing obfuscation methods such as jjencode from 2009. While it has practical security-related uses, such as evading browser filters, obfuscating code, and generating XSS attack payloads, it also carries a strong joke-like aspect that highlights the oddities of the JavaScript specification.
summary_en: JSFuck holds a niche position, mentioned as teaching material illustrating the oddities of JavaScript's type coercion and as an obfuscation technique in the security field. It is used almost entirely for evading browser filters or as a joke rather than as a practical programming language.

name: Beatnik
problem: 一見すると意味の通らない英文(ビート詩のような散文)がそのままプログラムとして解釈されるという発想から作られた難解言語。各単語をボードゲーム「スクラブル」の得点計算ルールで採点し、その得点値(5〜17など)によってスタック操作・算術演算・入出力・条件分岐といった命令を決定する仕組みを持つ。プログラムの見た目を自然な英文に近づけることを狙った実験的・風刺的な言語である。
summary: 英単語のスクラブル得点で命令を決める、一見英文に見える難解言語。
problem_en: Beatnik is an esoteric language built on the idea that seemingly meaningless English prose — something like a beat poem — could be interpreted directly as a program. Each word is scored using the point-calculation rules of the board game Scrabble, and that score (values such as 5 through 17) determines an instruction: stack manipulation, arithmetic, I/O, or conditional branching. It is an experimental, satirical language aimed at making programs look like natural English text, created not for practical use but to enjoy the idea itself that "code can read like poetry."
summary_en: Beatnik holds a niche position, cited within the esoteric-language community as a representative example of the idea of "a program that looks like natural English." It is not used for practical purposes and is strongly characterized as wordplay and a joke.

name: CLIPS
problem: 1980年代半ば、NASAジョンソン宇宙センターでは高価な商用エキスパートシステムツールART*Inferenceに依存しており、コスト面やLisp専用ハードウェア環境への依存という課題を抱えていた。そこで低コストかつ移植性の高いC言語ベースのエキスパートシステム構築ツールとして開発された。Charles ForgyのOPS5に着想を得たルールベースの前向き連鎖推論とLisp風の構文を採用し、後にオブジェクト指向機能も統合された。汎用のCコンパイラがあれば動作する可搬性の高さから産業界・教育機関で広く採用され、Jessなど多くの派生言語に影響を与えた。
summary: NASAが開発した、Cベースで移植性の高いルールベースエキスパートシステム構築言語。
problem_en: In the mid-1980s, NASA's Johnson Space Center depended on the expensive commercial expert-system tool ART*Inference, which brought problems of cost and dependence on Lisp-specific hardware environments. CLIPS was developed to address this as a low-cost, highly portable, C-based tool for building expert systems. It adopted forward-chaining, rule-based inference inspired by Charles Forgy's OPS5, together with Lisp-like syntax, and object-oriented features were integrated later. Thanks to its high portability — running wherever a general-purpose C compiler is available — it was widely adopted in industry and education, and it influenced many derivative languages, Jess among them.
summary_en: CLIPS holds a niche position, still used today in some industrial, research, and educational settings to build rule-based expert systems. Although it has receded from mainstream development, its portability and proven track record have kept a loyal user base.

name: Jess
problem: 1990年代半ば、サンディア国立研究所ではJavaで構築するアプリケーションにルールベース推論機能を組み込みたいという要求があったが、C言語ベースのCLIPSはJava環境との統合が難しかった。そこでCLIPS言語をスーパーセットとして拡張し、Java仮想マシン上で動作してJavaオブジェクトを事実として直接操作できるルールエンジンとして開発された。Rete法によるパターンマッチングでルール集合と事実集合を継続的に評価する仕組みを持ち、商用のエキスパートシステムシェルとして利用された。
summary: CLIPSを拡張しJava環境に統合した、商用ルールベースエキスパートシステムシェル。
problem_en: In the mid-1990s, Sandia National Laboratories wanted to embed rule-based inference capability into applications built in Java, but the C-based CLIPS was difficult to integrate with a Java environment. Jess was developed to solve this: it extends the CLIPS language as a superset and runs on the Java Virtual Machine as a rule engine that can directly manipulate Java objects as facts. It continuously evaluates rule sets against fact sets through Rete-algorithm pattern matching, and was used as a commercial expert-system shell.
summary_en: Jess holds a niche position, still used today in some Java-based business systems and decision-support systems. It has a track record as a commercial rule engine, but it has receded from the mainstream with the rise of later open-source rule engines such as Drools.

name: Drools
problem: 2000年代初頭、Javaエンタープライズアプリケーションではビジネスルールをアプリケーションコードから分離し、非エンジニアでも把握・保守できる形で管理したいという需要が高まっていた。DrooolsはRete法を拡張した推論エンジンを用い、POJO(Plain Old Java Object)を事実として扱うことでJavaアプリケーションに自然に組み込めるビジネスルール管理システム(BRMS)として開発された。後にJBoss(Red Hat)、さらにApache Software Foundationへと開発母体が移り、KIEプラットフォームの中核コンポーネントとして現在も広く使われている。
summary: JavaベースのビジネスルールをRete法で処理するオープンソースのルールエンジン。
problem_en: In the early 2000s, Java enterprise applications increasingly needed to separate business rules from application code and manage them in a form that non-engineers could also understand and maintain. Drools was developed as a business rule management system (BRMS) that fits naturally into Java applications, using an inference engine that extends the Rete algorithm and treating POJOs (Plain Old Java Objects) as facts. Its governing organization later moved to JBoss (Red Hat) and then to the Apache Software Foundation, and it remains widely used today as a core component of the KIE platform.
summary_en: Drools is an actively developed and used system, widely adopted in the Java enterprise field as a core component of the KIE platform. Under ongoing development by the open-source community and Red Hat, it continues to be used today as an active business rule engine.

name: Planner
problem: 1960年代末のMITでは、自然演繹に基づく一様な導出(resolution)による定理証明が人工知能研究の主流アプローチだったが、Carl Hewittはこの手法が知識の手続き的構造を覆い隠し、証明も背理法に頼りがちで非効率だと考えた。そこで、目標(goal)や表明(assertion)のパターンに応じて任意の手続きを呼び出す「パターン主導手続き呼び出し」の仕組みを持ち、知識を手続きとして直接埋め込める言語を設計しようとした。
summary: Prologなど論理プログラミング言語やSmalltalkに直接影響を与えた先駆的言語で、現在は歴史的言語として位置づけられている。
problem_en: In the late 1960s at MIT, the dominant approach to artificial intelligence reasoning was uniform resolution-based theorem proving grounded in natural deduction. Carl Hewitt felt this method obscured the procedural structure of knowledge and relied heavily on inefficient proof-by-contradiction search. He therefore set out to design a language built around "pattern-directed invocation," in which goals and assertions could directly trigger arbitrary procedures through both forward and backward chaining, so that problem-solving knowledge could be embedded procedurally rather than expressed only as passive logical formulas.
summary_en: Planner is classified as a historical language (status: historical) with no active use today, but it occupies an important place in the history of AI programming languages. Its Micro-Planner subset, implemented in Lisp, powered Terry Winograd's landmark natural-language understanding system SHRDLU, and its ideas on pattern-directed procedure invocation directly shaped the design of Prolog while also influencing Smalltalk.

name: OPS5
problem: 1970年代後半、カーネギーメロン大学のCharles Forgyは、Allen Newellらの生産システム(production system)研究を踏まえ、数百から数千規則という大規模な知識ベースでも効率よく動作するルールベース言語を必要としていた。従来の生産システム実装ではパターンマッチングのコストが規則数の増加とともに膨らみ、実用的なエキスパートシステム構築の障害になっていた。ForgyはReteアルゴリズムを用いた効率的な前向き連鎖推論エンジンを組み込むことでこの課題の解決を図った。
summary: DECのVAXコンフィグレーションを行ったR1/XCONなど初期の実用的エキスパートシステムを支えた言語で、現在は歴史的言語として位置づけられ、後継のCLIPSにその名称と構文が受け継がれている。
problem_en: In the late 1970s, Charles Forgy at Carnegie Mellon University, building on Allen Newell's research group's work on production systems, needed a rule-based language that could scale efficiently to knowledge bases containing hundreds or even thousands of rules. Earlier production-system implementations suffered from pattern-matching costs that grew with the number of rules, which became a practical bottleneck for building real-world expert systems. Forgy addressed this by incorporating his own Rete algorithm into OPS5's forward-chaining inference engine, so that only the working-memory elements that had actually changed needed to be re-matched against the rule set.
summary_en: OPS5 is a historical language (status: historical) no longer in active use, but it holds a landmark place in AI history as the language behind R1/XCON, one of the first widely deployed commercial expert systems, used by Digital Equipment Corporation to configure VAX computer orders. Its name and syntax were later carried forward directly into Charles Forgy's spiritual successor, CLIPS.

name: Ripple
problem: 2000年代半ば、セマンティックWeb上のRDFデータは急速に増加していたが、SPARQLのような宣言的クエリ言語だけでは、RDFグラフ上を経路的にたどりながらデータを変換・合成するスクリプト的な操作を簡潔に書くのが難しかった。Joshua Shinavierは、XPathのような経路式とForth・Factorのようなポストフィックス型のスタックベース関数型言語の考え方を組み合わせ、プログラム自体もRDFとして表現・埋め込み可能な言語を作ろうとした。
summary: Apache TinkerPopのGremlinの設計に影響を与えたことで知られるが、Ripple自体はニッチな研究・実験的言語にとどまり、現在は活発な開発が見られない歴史的言語として位置づけられる。
problem_en: In the mid-2000s, RDF data on the Semantic Web was growing rapidly, but declarative query languages such as SPARQL made it awkward to express scripting-style operations that walk and transform RDF graphs path by path. Joshua Shinavier designed Ripple to combine XPath-like path expressions with the postfix, stack-based style of concatenative functional languages such as Forth and Factor, so that programs could both query Linked Data and be embedded as RDF data themselves — every Ripple program has its own RDF representation and can be published and shared as part of the Web of Data.
summary_en: Ripple is best known today for having influenced the design of Apache TinkerPop's Gremlin graph traversal language, which lists Ripple among its direct influences in its Wikipedia infobox. Ripple itself, however, remained a niche research and experimental project — implemented in Java by Joshua Shinavier and documented mainly through academic papers and a GitHub wiki — and saw no further active development after the mid-2010s, so it is treated here as a historical language.

name: COMIT
problem: 1950年代後半、MITのVictor Yngveらは機械翻訳や言語学研究のための計算処理を必要としていたが、当時のFortranやアセンブリ言語には文字列を構造的に検索・書き換えする機能がなく、自然言語のような複雑な文字列データを扱うのに適していなかった。Yngveは、IBM 700/7000シリーズ上で文字列パターンのマッチングと書き換えを直接記述できる言語を設計し、機械翻訳研究を支援しようとした。
summary: 最初期の文字列処理言語として、後のSNOBOLに直接影響を与えたことで知られるが、現在では使われておらず、記録も断片的にしか残っていない歴史的言語である。
problem_en: In the late 1950s, Victor Yngve and collaborators at MIT needed computational support for machine translation and linguistic research, but the Fortran and assembly languages of the era had no facilities for structurally searching and rewriting strings, making them poorly suited to handling the complex textual data involved in natural language processing. Yngve designed COMIT, which ran on the IBM 700/7000 series, to let researchers directly express string pattern matching and rewriting as core language operations, in support of machine translation work.
summary_en: COMIT is remembered today primarily as the first string-processing language and as a direct influence on SNOBOL, whose designers built on its pattern-and-replace approach to text according to SNOBOL's own Wikipedia infobox. COMIT saw active use and development from 1957 to around 1965 (including a later COMIT II implementation for MIT's Compatible Time-Sharing System), but it has long since fallen out of use, and even English-language documentation about it remains only fragmentary — its Wikipedia article is itself marked as a stub — so it is treated here as a historical language.

name: Alphard
problem: 大規模プログラムの信頼性を高めるには、データ型の仕様と実装を形式的に対応付けて検証できる仕組みが必要だった。CMUのWulfらは、抽象データ型の仕様と実装を一体化した「form」という構文要素を核に、構造化と形式検証を両立する言語を設計しようとした。
summary: 実装系は一度も作られず研究論文の中だけに存在した言語だが、そのアイデアはEuclidなど検証志向の言語設計に影響を与えた。
problem_en: In the 1970s, as software systems grew larger, researchers needed a way to tie together the formal specification of a data type ("what it should do") with its procedural implementation ("how it does it"), so that programs could be both well-structured and formally verified. William A. Wulf, Mary Shaw, and Ralph L. London at Carnegie Mellon University proposed Alphard as a Pascal-based language whose central construct, the "form," unified a specification and an executable implementation of an abstract data type, aiming to support both structured programming and mechanical verification of correctness.
summary_en: Alphard was never implemented as a working compiler or interpreter; it existed only as a design described across a series of research papers in the mid-to-late 1970s. Despite this, its ideas about combining specification and implementation in a single abstraction directly influenced later verification-oriented systems languages such as Euclid, and it remains a reference point in the history of programming-language research on data abstraction and formal verification.

name: Gypsy
problem: テキサス大学オースティン校のCertifiable Minicomputer Projectでは、通信処理などのシステムプログラムについて、性質を形式的に証明したり実行時に検証したりできる「検証可能な」言語が求められていた。Ambler、Goodらは、Pascalに似た文法を採用しつつ、仕様記述機能と並行プロセス・メッセージパッシングの機構を統合した言語Gypsyを設計した。
summary: historicalな言語であり実務で使われることはないが、形式検証を意識したPascal系言語としてEuclidの設計に影響を与えた。
problem_en: In the mid-1970s, the Certifiable Minicomputer Project at the University of Texas at Austin needed a language for writing systems software (particularly communications-processing code) whose behavior could be formally proven correct or validated at run time. Allen L. Ambler, Donald I. Good, and colleagues designed Gypsy with Pascal-like syntax, adding specification facilities, concurrent processes, and inter-process communication via named mailboxes, so that ordinary programming and its formal verification could be expressed within a single language.
summary_en: Gypsy is a historical language with no modern practical use. An early compiler and supporting verification tools were built for it as part of UT Austin's Certifiable Minicomputer Project, and its emphasis on formally verifiable, Pascal-like systems code placed it among the languages Wikipedia's Euclid article cites as a direct influence on Euclid.

name: LIS
problem: 1970年代前半、フランスのCII社(後にHoneywell Bullと合併)は、自社メインフレーム向けに信頼性の高いシステムソフトウェアを記述するための言語を必要としていた。Jean Ichbiahは、Pascalのデータ構造とSUEの制御構造を取り入れ、Simulaの考え方も参照しながら、システム実装向けの言語LISを設計した。
summary: 商用採用は限定的だったが、Ada-0コンパイラの実装などに使われ、後にAdaを設計するIchbiahの経験を形作った前史として位置づけられる。
problem_en: In the early-to-mid 1970s, the French computer manufacturer CII (later merged into Honeywell Bull) needed a language for writing reliable systems software for its Honeywell-based mainframes. Jean Ichbiah designed LIS (Langage d'Implémentation de Systèmes, "System Implementation Language") by combining Pascal's data structures with SUE's control structures, while also drawing on Simula's ideas, to create a language suited to systems implementation.
summary_en: LIS saw only limited commercial adoption, but it was used experimentally, for instance to implement a compiler for the Ada-0 subset of Ada at Karlsruhe on the Siemens BS2000 operating system. Its greatest significance lies in having shaped the thinking of Jean Ichbiah, who went on to lead the design of Ada for the U.S. Department of Defense, making LIS an important piece of prehistory in the story of Ada's creation.

name: SUE
problem: 1971年、トロント大学のComputer Systems Research Groupは、IBM System/360向けに独自のオペレーティングシステムを書くための、構造化と拡張性に優れたシステム記述言語を必要としていた。Dennis Tsichritzis、Jim Horning、Ric Holt、J. W. Atwoodらが立ち上げたProject SUEは、型検査付きの分割コンパイルとプログラムライブラリ機構を備えたシステム言語SUEを開発した。
summary: historicalな言語であり実務で使われることはないが、トロント大学における一連のシステム記述言語研究(後のLIS、Euclid、SP/k、Turingなど)の源流の一つとして参照される。
problem_en: In 1971, the Computer Systems Research Group at the University of Toronto needed a well-structured, extensible systems-implementation language in which to write a new operating system for the IBM System/360 family. Project SUE, proposed by Dennis Tsichritzis, Jim Horning, Ric Holt, and J. W. Atwood, produced the SUE language, described in the paper "The System Language for Project SUE" by Barry L. Clark and Jim Horning, together with type-checked separate compilation of internal procedures and a program library system.
summary_en: SUE is a historical language with no current practical use, but it stands as one of the sources of a lineage of systems-implementation and teaching languages developed at the University of Toronto, including later languages such as LIS, Euclid, SP/k, and Turing.

name: SP/k
problem: 1970年代前半、大学の初学者向けプログラミング教育では、PL/Iのような当時主流だった言語が複雑で冗長な機能を多く含み、教育目的には適していないという課題があった。トロント大学のRic Holt、David B. Wortman、David T. Barnard、James Cordyは、PL/Iのサブセットを段階的に拡張していくSP/1からSP/8までの一連の言語群SP/kを設計し、構造化プログラミングを自然に学べるようにした。
summary: historicalな言語であり実務での使用はないが、北米の多くの大学で教育に使われ、同じ設計者らによるTuringの設計に直接つながった教育史上重要な言語である。
problem_en: In the early-to-mid 1970s, introductory university programming courses were often taught using industrial languages such as PL/I, which contained many complex and redundant features poorly suited to teaching beginners. Ric Holt, David B. Wortman, David T. Barnard, and James Cordy at the University of Toronto designed SP/k, a graded sequence of language subsets (SP/1 through SP/8) built on PL/I, each self-contained and precisely defined, to let students learn structured programming incrementally without being burdened by unnecessary language complexity.
summary_en: SP/k is a historical language no longer in active use, but for roughly a decade it was adopted for teaching at more than 40 universities, schools, and research laboratories across Canada and the United States. It fed directly into the design of Turing by the same University of Toronto team (Holt and Cordy), making it an important stepping stone in the history of programming-language pedagogy.

name: ksh(Korn Shell)
problem: 1980年代初頭、標準シェルであったBourne Shellはコマンドライン編集やコマンド履歴、ジョブ制御といった対話的な使い勝手に乏しかった。一方でCシェル(csh)は対話性を備えていたもののBourne Shellとスクリプト互換性が無く、Unixのシェル環境は互換性の異なる二系統に分かれていた。David KornはBourne Shell互換の構文を保ちながら、Cシェルのような対話的な便利機能を統合したシェルを作ろうとした。
summary: AIXなど商用UNIXの既定シェルとして今も使われ続け、BashやZshの機能面にも影響を与えた。
problem_en:
By the early 1980s, the Bourne shell was the standard interactive and scripting shell on Unix, but it lacked convenient interactive features such as command-line editing, command history, and job control. The C shell (csh) offered some of these interactive conveniences, but its scripting syntax was incompatible with the Bourne shell, splitting the Unix shell world into two poorly compatible camps.

David Korn at Bell Labs set out to design a new shell, initially built from Bourne shell source code, that preserved full Bourne shell script compatibility while adding interactive features requested by Bell Labs users, including command-line editing modes borrowed from vi and emacs, command history, job control, and more powerful scripting constructs such as arrays and arithmetic evaluation.
summary_en:
KornShell remains in active use today. It has long been the default shell on IBM AIX, and its open-source derivative mksh serves as the default shell on Android. Community and vendor-maintained variants such as ksh93u+m and ksh2020 continue to receive updates, and some Linux distributions package it as an available or default shell.

Beyond its own continued use, ksh's design—particularly its command-line editing, completion, and scripting extensions—directly influenced later shells such as Bash and Zsh, cementing its place as a key link between the classic Bourne shell and modern interactive shells.

name: EXEC 2
problem: IBMのVM/CMS環境で使われていた初代EXEC(CMS EXEC)は機能が乏しく、8バイトのトークン長制限やユーザー定義関数の欠如など、複雑な処理を書くには力不足だった。EXEC 2はCMS EXECとの互換性を保ちながら、トークン長制限の撤廃やユーザー定義関数、サブコマンド環境のサポートなど機能を拡張した後継スクリプト言語として作られた。
summary: REXXに置き換えられて久しいが、z/VM環境では今もCMS EXEC・REXXと並んでサポートされ続けている歴史的言語。
problem_en:
On IBM's VM/CMS systems, the original CMS EXEC scripting language (written by Stuart Madnick, modeled on CTSS RUNCOM) was widely used for command procedures, but it had significant limitations: tokens were restricted to 8 bytes, statements could not exceed a short length, and there was no support for user-defined functions, making it unsuitable for more complex automation tasks.

EXEC 2 was introduced as a successor that stayed largely compatible with CMS EXEC syntax (requiring scripts to begin with an &TRACE statement) while removing the 8-byte token restriction, allowing statements up to 255 characters, and adding user-defined functions and subcommand environment support—proving out the concept of a general-purpose macro/scripting language on CMS.
summary_en: EXEC 2 was eventually superseded by Rexx, which Mike Cowlishaw designed explicitly as a more powerful and easier-to-learn successor to EXEC and EXEC 2. Today EXEC 2 is a historical language: IBM's z/VM still supports it alongside CMS EXEC and Rexx for backward compatibility, but essentially all new scripting on IBM mainframe/VM systems is done in Rexx or other modern languages, with EXEC 2 surviving mainly in legacy automation scripts.

name: ed
problem: 初期のUnix開発において、限られたメモリと低速なテレタイプ端末という制約の中で、ソースコードやテキストファイルを編集するための実用的な手段が必要だった。Ken Thompsonは、UC BerkeleyのQEDエディタから着想を得て、1行ずつテキストを操作しコマンドで編集・検索・置換を行うラインエディタと、それを操作するための簡潔なコマンド言語を設計した。
summary: 対話的な直接利用は稀だが、POSIX標準の一部として今も全てのUnix系システムに存在し、sedなど後続ツールの原型として位置づけられている。
problem_en:
In August 1969, when Ken Thompson was building the earliest version of Unix at Bell Labs on a PDP-7, the system had extremely limited memory and was operated through slow teletype terminals. There was a need for a text editor that could work within these constraints and let programmers create and modify source code and other text files line by line.
